jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Oracle Fusion (PowerPlan/Distribution & New Construction/Transmission and )
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Senior Project Managers (Oracle Fusion)**

**Location: 100% Remote**

**Duration: 12+ Months Contract**

**Position Overview:** Seeking Senior Project Managers to lead workstream initiatives within a large-scale Oracle Fusion enterprise transformation replacing SAP. Each Senior Project Manager will own planning, scheduling, and risk and issue tracking for an assigned functional module and report progress to the Program Office. Each requisition should be tagged with its applicable module.

**3 total roles, 1 for each module listed**

* **Operations (Transmission and Distribution [T&D] and Generation)**
* **Distribution & New Construction (DNC)**
* **PowerPlan (asset, tax, and property accounting)**

**Responsibilities:**

* Own initiative-level planning, scheduling, and work breakdown for the assigned module.
* Track and manage initiative-specific risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and action items; escalate to the Program Office as needed.
* Coordinate with business and IT leads to ensure module requirements, timelines, and dependencies are understood and managed.
* Manage one or more Project Coordinators or Junior Project Managers supporting the initiative.
* Provide regular status updates on progress, risks, and blockers to the Program Office.
* Support data conversion, testing, training, and deployment activities relevant to the module in coordination with Cross-Pillar Services teams.
* For Operations and DNC modules, coordinate work involving Maximo work and asset management, geographic information systems (GIS), and field mobility systems.
* For Finance and PowerPlan modules, coordinate work involving general ledger (GL), accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), fixed assets, and capital or PowerPlan asset accounting.
* For Human Resources, coordinate work across Payroll, Benefits, Talent Management, Recruiting and Onboarding, Learning, and related HCM processes.
* For Supply Chain Management, coordinate work across Supplier Management, Procurement, Sourcing, Inventory, and Demand and Supply Planning.

**Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of project or program management experience, including enterprise ERP implementation experience.
* Oracle Fusion implementation experience is required; module-specific experience in HCM, Financials, SCM, or a related area is preferred.
* Experience leading or supporting a SAP-to-Oracle Fusion migration is strongly preferred.
* Experience managing initiative-level planning, scheduling, and risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) tracking within a larger program structure.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work directly with business and IT leads.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or equivalent education and work experience.
* Experience supporting multi-year enterprise transformation engagements.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.
* Utility industry experience is a plus, but not required.

**Tools and Technologies:**

* Oracle Fusion applications, including HCM, Financials, and SCM, based on assigned module.
* SAP migration environments.
* Maximo, GIS, and field mobility systems for applicable Operations and DNC workstreams.
* PowerPlan and ERP accounting modules for applicable Finance and PowerPlan workstreams.
* Project planning, scheduling, status reporting, and RAID management tools.

Pay: $60.00 - $65.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**You Belong at Greenway**

Bring your best and truest self. We celebrate what makes us different and what brings us all together. At Greenway Health, we are committed to an inclusive environment and a culture of belonging as we pursue our purpose of healthier communities, successful providers, and empowered patients. We are united in our goal to build the future of healthcare technology. Join us.

As a Program Manager (AI Native), you will drive delivery across a multi-product program—owning cross-functional outcomes for a product line, anticipating problems before they surface, forcing timely decisions, removing blockers across teams, and holding product, engineering, and partner teams to their commitments. You are a driver and a doer: you act without waiting to be asked, you own the outcome, and you never confuse reporting on delivery with delivering. Status reporting is an output of this role, not the job itself.

You will operate in an environment with multiple products, many cross-functional stakeholders, and competing priorities. You will manage program scope, schedule, resources, communications, risks, issues, cross-product dependencies, roadmap capacity, and release readiness, and ensure that Wrike, Agility (or Jira or other ALM), Smartsheet, Domo, and related planning systems accurately reflect reality so they can be used to act, not just to report.

AI gives you leverage. You bring judgment. You remain accountable for validating AI-assisted outputs, protecting sensitive information, and making delivery decisions that are accurate, transparent, and aligned to business needs.

Key Outcomes

* Drive program, release, and roadmap commitments across multiple products and teams to completion, with predictable, on-time delivery.

* Get ahead of cross-product risks, dependencies, and slippage—act on them and drive them to resolution before they become delivery problems.

* Force clarity on competing priorities: bring executives and stakeholders the decisions, trade-offs, and escalations needed to keep the program on track, not just status updates.

* Keep program delivery data in Wrike, Agility (or Jira or other ALM), Smartsheet, and Domo accurate, current, and traceable across products so it can be used to make decisions and trigger action.

* Ground program and release commitments in real team and roadmap capacity across the product line.

* Ensure every release is ready across product, engineering, and cross-functional teams.

* Use AI, analytics, and approved agentic AI tools responsibly to anticipate risks, forecast capacity, and accelerate delivery decisions.

Success Measures / Accountable Outcomes

* Program and release commitments across the product line are met with strong say/do, predictability, and minimal spillover.

* Project Managers assigned to the product line’s delivery teams, whether direct or dotted-line reports, consistently meet their delivery commitments and keep their project data accurate and current.

* Cross-product risks, issues, dependencies, and slippage are anticipated early and driven to resolution, not just surfaced.

* Competing priorities are resolved through timely, well-framed decisions; stalled decisions are escalated before they put delivery at risk.

* Wrike, Agility (or Jira or other ALM), Smartsheet, and Domo data is accurate, current, and traceable, with the program RAID log updated at least weekly.

* Program and release commitments reflect real team and roadmap capacity.

* Releases are ready on time across all cross-functional teams.

* Agentic software development KPIs are tracked, understood, and acted on, so AI-agent contributions improve delivery speed and quality without adding hidden rework or risk.

* Executives and cross-functional stakeholders get timely decisions, trade-offs, and escalations that keep delivery on track, backed by transparent reporting on actual program health and progress.

* AI-assisted work is reviewed, validated, and used responsibly.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Serve as the accountable program manager for a product line; own end-to-end program delivery outcomes across multiple products, teams, and releases.
* Hold the Project Managers assigned to the product line’s delivery teams accountable for their delivery commitments, whether they report directly to this role or on a dotted-line basis; set clear expectations, review their plans, RAID logs, and delivery data, intervene early when commitments are at risk, and escalate performance concerns to their line manager as needed.
* Plan and drive cross-organization programs using Agile and traditional program management practices; translate roadmap and portfolio priorities into integrated program plans, milestones, and release commitments.
* Personally drive the work forward: anticipate obstacles, identify cross-product trends before they become delivery problems, take early corrective action, and escalate when appropriate—without waiting to be asked.
* Navigate competing priorities across products and stakeholders; surface conflicts early, frame options and trade-offs, drive decisions to closure, and hold owners accountable for follow-through.
* Manage program scope, schedule, budget, resources, communications, cross-product and cross-team dependencies, and delivery progress.
* Regularly communicate with and manage expectations of executive stakeholders; represent the product line’s programs, plans, timelines, risks, and required decisions in a concise, action-oriented way.
* Serve on the product leadership team alongside development and product management; foster effective communication and alignment across product areas and cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Mission Underwriting Services**

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best—underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

**What We Offer:**

* Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* 401K, 401K Match
* Life and Disability Benefits
* Unaccrued Paid Time Off
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Employee Discounts
* Employee Assistance Program
* Educational Assistance Program
* Employee Referral Program
* Paid Parental Leave

**About The Role**

The Business Analyst will work alongside a diverse team, including vendors, to drive the design and implementation of technology platforms to fit the business current requirements and future enhancements of Mission.

**What You'll Do**

* Analyze business requirements and determine the appropriate tools and approaches, and the application of standards and best practices. Collaborate with other team members to adhere to our standards, framework, and best practices for delivery of technology applications and products.
* Work with team members to adhere to repeatable and scalable processes for the collection, design, and prioritization of work.
* Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders to identify emerging trends, needs and opportunities to provide distinctive value and outcomes from the services and data.
* Maintain a strategic outlook and stay current with leading technology products and techniques.
* Develop and maintain a working knowledge of key business processes to be seen as a trusted advisor to the business in bringing technology to bear on business problems and procedures.
* Conduct testing of software deployment and updates.
* Assist in managing projects, including developing project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Participate in testing and quality assurance of systems and processes.
* Provide support and training to end-users on new systems and processes.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field; OR 5+ years of progressive experience in financial services, insurance, or data analytics industry.
* Proven success in business requirements gathering, design and development proper documentation for prioritization within the overall roadmap and technology direction.
* Knowledge of business key performance indicators (KPIs) with a preference in KPIs for the risk, insurance, and claims industry.
* Demonstrated ability in business facilitation and effective use of project management techniques/tools.
* Client facing experience is required
* Ability to travel up to 15% of the year

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years Insurance Company, MGA or TPA experience preferred.
* 5+ years of Business Analyst experience preferred.
* Experience in the commercial insurance industry and regulatory environment.
* Project management experience and managing business projects for the full life cycle, from inception to implementation.
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* Understands the fundamentals of commercial insurance and claims processes/services.
* Working knowledge of insurance technology (i.e., policy and program admin systems)
* Understanding of Agile project management and development process

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills required to effectively work with a variety of business partners and distribution partners.
* Ability to work dynamically between IT, Operations, and Underwriting Programs is required.
* Self-motivated and innovative with the ability to set direction, organize and manage own work, and effectively work in collaboration with others.
* Ability to synthesize requests, uncover inherent trends, make recommendations about associated implications to business performance, communicate findings and recommendations to a variety of audiences and overall technology roadmap.
* Ability to acquire core business acumen within a given industry or customer segment
* Relationship building
* Conflict resolution
* Team player
* Project management
* Financial analysis
* Commercial acumen
* Communication and presentation acumen

**This is a remote position. Planned, in-office activities may be required on occasion (typically 2-4x per year).**

**You must live in the United States and be authorized to work in the United States without requirement of employment****sponsorship/visa.**

**Description**
===============

**Partner Operations Program Manager (Contract)**
-------------------------------------------------

*Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Microsoft through external staffing partners of Allegis Global Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by AGS and will not be an employee of Microsoft.*

### **Summary:**

We are seeking a highly organized and relationship-oriented Partner Operations Program Manager to support a global education-focused partner ecosystem. This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day partnership operations, coordinating cross-functional activities, supporting external partners, and driving operational excellence across partner onboarding, enablement, reporting, financial processes, and ongoing business management activities.

The successful candidate will serve as a key operational lead between external partners and internal business teams, ensuring partnership initiatives move forward efficiently and stakeholders have the visibility, information, and support needed to achieve success. This role requires strong program management capabilities, exceptional organizational skills, business operations experience, and the ability to drive multiple workstreams simultaneously while identifying opportunities to improve processes and scale operations. This is a fully remote role with flexibility to accommodate time zone differences.

* Coordinate partner onboarding activities, enablement programs, business reviews, operational planning, and ongoing partner engagement efforts.

* Support special projects and strategic partnership initiatives as business needs require.

### **Requirements:**

* 2-4 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Business Operations, Partner Operations, Partner Management, or a related operational discipline.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams, deliverables, stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines.
* Experience supporting external partners through onboarding, ongoing operations, business reviews, reporting, and cross-functional coordination.

jobs.title: Senior Design Project Manager
jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

**Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Title:** Senior Design Project Manager

**Position Location:** Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Design Project Manager is accountable for leading all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owner, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in commercial and mission critical environments.

On a per project basis, the role will include leading the design and construction administration phases of projects including performing site visits, leading and representing DLB in client meetings, coordinating with internal and external members, and general project overhead tasks.

The Senior Design Project Manager will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects or assignments. Will lead project teams of routine or complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

The Senior Project Manager will communicate and operate in line with organizational and client goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Manage all Elements of Routine and Complex Projects (50%)**

* Drive project design from inception (site acquisition) through design and construction
* Develop owner project requirements (OPR) and initial space planning efforts / schematic design
* Represent DLB at site visits including existing condition surveys and punchlists
* Evaluate and review subcontractor proposals and provide recommendations on contract award
* Lead pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals
* Coordinate resource and material forecasting
* Develop, manage and monitor schedule
* Lead project meetings
* Coordinate / perform QA / QC plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals
* Oversee / coordinate subconsultant activities
* Develop cost and time schedules for proposed work with the assistance of project team. Assign and schedule duties to project team members.
* Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout

**Monitor and Control Project Financials (25%)**

* Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall accountability for the profitability of the project
* Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required
* Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines
* Accountable for development of cost schedules / schedules of value for client progress billing

**Manage Stakeholder Relations (20%)**

* Lead preparation of proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm
* Lead the promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients
* Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects
* Primary contact for clients and build effective, long-term client relationships
* Ensure client satisfaction through active communication

**Administrative (5%)**

* Review and distribute daily reporting
* Accountable for project contract administration
* Manage personal and project hours using company tools
* Create / complete departmental reports
* Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

**Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency**

* Identify opportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
* Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
* Promote a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology to optimize performance and scalability.

*Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned*

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)**

* Knowledge of industry trends, project management and construction procedures and best practices
* Knowledge of MEP / FA / FP trades and the general requirements for each
* Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods and coordination of people and resources
* Knowledge of materials, methods and the tools involved in the construction mission critical, commercial buildings or other structures
* Skilled at producing drawings and visual aids using AutoCAD and / or Revit
* Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
* Skilled at using construction management software such as Procore
* Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail

jobs.title: Project Manager, Technology Transformation
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Accommodations Plus International (API) is a technology and services company focused on driving innovation across the travel and transportation industry. We partner with organizations in the airline, cruise, and rail sectors to deliver solutions that improve layover operations, enhance customer experience, and support long-term growth.

Our mission is to make layovers simpler and more efficient for crew members—and we bring that to life through deep industry expertise and a practical, results-driven approach.

Today, API’s platform powers over 18 million crew room nights each year for 100+ airlines and travel operators worldwide. Our Global Reach ensures that airline crews are rested, transported, and connected so global aviation runs on time.

At API, we’re building a culture rooted in succeeding and thriving together. It’s a place where people are encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills, and contribute to work that matters.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a company that values steady progress, real impact, and long-term development, we’d like to meet you!

==================================

* **FLSA Status:** Exempt
* **Department:** Operations – Project Management Office (PMO)

Position Summary 
**The Project Manager leads client-facing IT infrastructure and managed services projects from initiation through closure. This role translates technical scope into practical project plans, coordinates technical teams, vendors, procurement, and client stakeholders, and keeps projects aligned with scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. By delivering organized, proactive project leadership, this position strengthens the client experience, supports timely delivery and revenue, and expands the Project Management Office’s capacity.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of client-facing IT projects, including managed services onboardings, migrations, offboardings, infrastructure implementations, cybersecurity deployments, hardware refreshes, and environment upgrades.
* Review statements of work, technical requirements, budgets, dependencies, and resource needs to confirm delivery readiness before kickoff.
* Develop clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, go-live checkpoints, and transition-to-support activities.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects while monitoring scope, schedules, budgets, labor hours, documentation, client commitments, and hardware or vendor dependencies.
* Lead client-facing and internal project meetings, communicate status and decisions, and ensure required actions are completed.
* Coordinate engineers, technical leads, Procurement, Account Management, Sales, vendors, and client stakeholders across interdependent workstreams.
* Identify risks, scope changes, blockers, and conflicting requirements early; recommend solutions and escalate decisions when needed.
* Validate implementation readiness, quality assurance, client acceptance, billing milestones, and closure criteria.
* Maintain accurate project records and status updates in project management systems and contribute to process improvements and lessons learned.
* Build trusted relationships while setting clear expectations, holding owners accountable, and maintaining a confident, solutions-oriented approach.

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Project Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least four years of experience managing client-facing IT infrastructure or managed services projects in an MSP, technology services provider, consulting organization, or similarly complex customer-facing environment.
* Experience leading projects involving several of the following: networking, servers, endpoints, Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, identity and access, cybersecurity, migrations, hardware deployment, site readiness, or IT environment assessments.
* Ability to interpret statements of work, technical requirements, and solution documentation and turn them into actionable delivery plans.
* Strong knowledge of project controls, including scope, schedule, budget, resource planning, risk and issue management, acceptance criteria, and go-live readiness.
* Experience coordinating technical resources, vendors, procurement, account teams, and clients across resource-constrained, interdependent workstreams.
* Proven ability to identify technical and operational risks, resolve ambiguity, manage scope changes, and escalate issues with clear recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to facilitate technical discussions, hold owners accountable, and present concise updates to clients and leadership.
* Proficiency with project management platforms and Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience supporting healthcare, senior care, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with ConnectWise, Jira, GuideCX, or a comparable project management platform.
* PMP, CAPM, CompTIA Project+, Network+, Security+, ITIL, or another relevant project management or technical certification.
* Experience managing a high-volume project portfolio in a resource-constrained environment.

What Success Looks Like 
**A high-performing Project Manager keeps a complex portfolio moving with clear plans, accurate documentation, proactive risk management, and consistent follow-through. Success is demonstrated through confident client communication, strong accountability across technical and cross-functional teams, timely and effective project delivery, and a positive impact on client satisfaction, team capacity, and business performance.**

jobs.description:
Our client, a global technology and financial services company, is seeking an **Intelligence Analyst.**

This role is focused on three core operational areas: 314(b) request processing, SAR supporting documentation fulfillment, and intelligence referral triage and intake.

In this role, you will serve as a central triage point for the Intelligence Program's internal and external referrals, process and respond to 314(b) requests, and manage law enforcement supporting documentation requests. You will conduct open-source and internal research, assess exposure across Client platforms, route qualified referrals to the appropriate investigative queues, and ensure all activity is tracked and documented in accordance with program standards.

This is a **remote** **12-month contract position.** Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. No H-1B visa sponsorship available. Hourly rate: **$45.56. No C2C.**

**Responsibilities**

**Intelligence Triage & Intake**

* Serve as a central intake and triage point for internal and external intelligence referrals submitted via designated channels (internal referral forms, shared inboxes, etc.)
* Review incoming internal referrals against established program criteria to determine acceptance or rejection, documenting the rationale for all triage decisions
* Process external referrals from law enforcement, child safety organizations, and non-governmental agencies by logging, researching, and triaging incoming leads
* Conduct exposure and account matching across all Client product platforms using available identifiers (names, DOBs, SSNs, Cashtags, email addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses, BTC wallet information, etc.)
* Utilize open-source intelligence (OSINT) techniques and internal tools to identify and document associations between referred activity and Client customer accounts
* Determine and document triage outcomes (e.g., assignment created, no exposure, exposure but covered, exposure but no activity) and update tracking systems accordingly
* Route accepted referrals by creating investigation cases with appropriate tags (patterns, origins, products) and assigning them to the correct investigative queues
* Process employee/contractor referrals with appropriate sensitivity handling and restricted queue routing
* Support post-SAR law enforcement outreach by collecting SAR-related metadata and escalating it to team leads for formal dissemination
* Maintain accurate records across all intake trackers and assignment logs

**314(b) Request Processing**

* Receive, track, document, and triage all 314(b) requests from member institutions, ensuring timely and accurate responses
* Conduct open-source and internal database checks on subjects related to 314(b) requests
* Maintain accurate records and reporting on all 314(b) request activity, turnaround times, and outcomes

**SAR Supporting Documentation Fulfillment**

* Monitor and act upon SAR supporting documentation requests from law enforcement
* Track and document each request and follow up with law enforcement regarding any additional inquiries
* Interact with internal stakeholders to ensure full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and policies
* Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate internal teams as needed

**Qualifications**

**You have:**

* 2+ years of experience in EDD, transaction monitoring, compliance/AML, or intelligence analysis with a financial institution, law enforcement agency, or payment-focused company
* Direct experience with intelligence triage, case intake, or referral processing in a financial crimes or compliance environment
* Experience processing 314(b) requests and/or fulfilling law enforcement documentation requests
* Knowledge of BSA/AML regulations, risks, and typologies
* Demonstrated ability to conduct exposure checks and account matching across multiple platforms and data sources
* Proficiency with open-source intelligence (OSINT) research and collection techniques
* A strong operations mindset with the ability to manage time-sensitive directives and self-manage workflow across competing priorities
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills for tracking high volumes of requests and referrals
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfort working within structured workflows and documenting decisions with clear rationale
* AS/BS Degree and relevant experience

**Even Better**

* Experience with SQL and/or Snowflake for conducting exposure and account research
* Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools (Chainalysis, TRM)
* Experience with TLOxp, LexisNexis, or similar investigative databases
* Relevant industry certifications (CAMS, CFE, CFCS, CRCM)
* Prior experience working with FinCEN's 314(b) information-sharing program
* Experience handling sensitive employee/contractor investigations with appropriate discretion

jobs.description:
**Senior Techno-Functional Business Analyst (Patient Master, Consent Master & Preference Center) - Onsite**

**Domain**

Life Sciences / Commercial Data & Master Data Management (MDM)

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Techno-Functional Business Analyst** with deep expertise in **Patient Master**, **Consent Master**, and **Consent & Preference Management** solutions. The ideal candidate will bridge business and technology teams, translating business requirements into scalable API-driven solutions and supporting integrations across MDM platforms, CRM systems, patient services, marketing platforms, and downstream data consumers.

The candidate should possess a strong understanding of **MuleSoft APIs**, data integration patterns, Python-based data analysis, healthcare data models, consent governance, and end-to-end SDLC delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis & Requirement Management**

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from Patient Services, Commercial Operations, Marketing, Privacy, Compliance, and Data Governance stakeholders.
* Create BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Flows, Data Mapping Documents, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Conduct workshops and facilitate requirement discovery sessions.
* Define AS-IS and TO-BE processes for Patient Master and Consent Management ecosystems.
* Support backlog grooming, sprint planning, and UAT activities.

**Patient Master Domain**

* Define patient onboarding, identity resolution, matching, merging, survivorship, and golden record requirements.
* Document patient data integration requirements across:
* Patient Support Programs
* HUB Systems
* Digital Therapeutic Platforms
* Patient Portals
* CRM Systems
* Data Platforms
* Collaborate with MDM teams to establish patient data governance and stewardship processes.

**Consent & Preference Center**

* Define consent capture, update, revocation, and audit trail requirements.
* Analyze:
* Explicit consent
* Implicit consent
* Opt-in / Opt-out management
* Communication preferences
* Channel preferences
* Purpose-based consent
* Support implementation of Preference Center capabilities across web, mobile, CRM, and marketing channels.
* Ensure compliance with privacy and regulatory requirements.

**API & Integration Analysis**

* Work closely with MuleSoft architects and developers to define:
* System interfaces
* API contracts
* Payload structures
* Data transformation rules
* Error handling mechanisms
* Event-driven integrations
* Create integration specifications using REST APIs, JSON, XML, and Swagger/OpenAPI standards.
* Define synchronization patterns between source systems and master platforms.

**Data Analysis & Technical Support**

* Perform data profiling and root-cause analysis using SQL and Python.
* Analyze source-to-target mappings.
* Support reconciliation and data quality assessments.
* Identify integration gaps and data inconsistencies.
* Participate in SIT, UAT, and production validation activities.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with:
* Business teams
* Product Owners
* Enterprise Architects
* MDM Teams
* Privacy & Compliance Teams
* MuleSoft Development Teams
* Provide executive-level requirement summaries and solution walkthroughs.

**Required Skills**

**Functional Skills**

* Patient Master Data Management
* Consent Management
* Preference Center Management
* Life Sciences Domain
* Data Governance
* Data Stewardship
* GDPR / HIPAA / Privacy Compliance
* Agile Scrum Methodology

**Technical Skills**

* MuleSoft API-led Connectivity
* REST APIs
* OpenAPI / Swagger
* JSON / XML
* SQL
* Python
* Data Mapping & Transformation
* Event-driven Architecture
* Batch & Real-time Integrations
* ETL Concepts

**Documentation Skills**

* BRD
* FRD
* User Stories
* Process Flow Diagrams
* Data Mapping Documents
* API Specifications
* Test Scenarios
* UAT Scripts

**Success Metrics**

* Requirement quality and completeness
* Reduction in API integration defects
* UAT success rate
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Data quality improvements
* Consent compliance adherence
* Delivery of sprint commitments
* Reduction in production issues

Pay: $55.00 - $63.00 per hour

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About us:

BDR Solutions, LLC, (BDR) supports the U.S. Federal Government in successfully achieving its mission and goals. Our service and solution delivery starts with understanding each client’s end-state, and then seamlessly integrating within each Agency’s organization to improve and enhance business and technical operations and deployments.

(Military Veterans are highly encouraged to apply)

Role Overview:

The Data Analyst (Journeyman) supports data migration, data quality analysis, reporting, and dashboard development activities within the Oracle Cloud Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data as it transitions from legacy systems to modern cloud-based platforms. The analyst will collaborate with functional and technical teams to validate data mappings, perform quality assurance activities, and develop reports and dashboards that support business decision-making and program objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* Support data migration efforts, including extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation of data from legacy systems into Oracle Cloud EPM.
* Perform data quality assessments to identify inconsistencies, anomalies, and data integrity issues.
* Validate legacy-to-target data mappings and confirm successful migration results.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, and analytical tools that provide actionable business insights.
* Utilize SQL and business intelligence (BI) tools to analyze data and generate reporting solutions.
* Collaborate with project stakeholders, business analysts, and technical teams to gather reporting requirements and define data validation processes.
* Document data migration activities, validation results, and reporting methodologies.
* Support testing activities, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and data verification efforts.
* Ensure adherence to organizational data governance, security, and quality standards.
* Provide analytical support during implementation and post-deployment activities.

Required Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of data analysis experience, preferably supporting ERP, financial systems, or enterprise application migrations.
* Experience supporting data migration and data validation initiatives in large-scale system implementations.
* Proficiency with SQL for data querying, analysis, and validation.
* Experience with reporting and business intelligence tools.
* Demonstrated experience validating legacy-to-target data mappings.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience performing data quality assessments and reconciliation activities.
* Ability to communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Nice to Have Qualifications:

* Experience supporting Oracle Cloud EPM implementations.
* Knowledge of financial data structures, ERP systems, or enterprise performance management solutions.
* Familiarity with data governance and data management best practices

The compensation range for this position is $110,000-154,000. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to location, skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

**﻿In addition, U.S Citizenship** is required. Applicants will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information and be able to obtain a government-granted security clearance. Individuals may also be subject to a background investigation including, but not limited to criminal history, employment and education verification, drug testing, and creditworthiness.

Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact TalentAcquisition@bdrsolutionsllc.com.

jobs.title: Chemical & Natural Resources Cybersecurity Manager/Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**We Are**

Accenture's Cybersecurity practice, a global leader in delivering end-to-end cybersecurity services across strategy, risk management, digital identity, cyber defense, and managed security. With security professionals in 70 countries and specialized facilities like Cyber Fusion Centers and Cyber Labs, we focus on embedding security into digital transformation programs, and delivering targeted cybersecurity solutions to protect digital assets, manage cybersecurity risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. We address the evolving challenges of cybersecurity in today's digital landscape. Our cybersecurity practice is supported by a global network of cybersecurity professionals, advanced tools, and partnerships with leading technology providers. We help organizations build resilience, protect their operations, and enable growth in a secure digital environment.

**You Are**

Passionate about leveraging cybersecurity innovation to drive strategic transformation across the Chemicals & Natural Resources (CNR) industries, including chemical manufacturers, oil & gas operators, mining companies, and agricultural enterprises. You develop and deliver cybersecurity services that protect critical infrastructure, enable operational modernization, manage enterprise and operational risk, and support compliance with industry-specific regulatory requirements. This role demands deep expertise across IT and OT environments and the ability to guide CNR clients through complex business, technology, safety, and resilience challenges. You assess current and future cybersecurity capabilities, advise on leading practices, and shape cybersecurity strategies aligned with each client's business priorities, regulatory obligations, and operational realities.

**The Work:**

As a Cybersecurity Manager, you will manage complex information security engagements and workstreams. You will provide cybersecurity subject matter expertise, coordinate project delivery, and serve as a key point of contact for client security, business, and IT stakeholders, Accenture domain experts, and third-party teams. You will lead; manage plans, risks, budgets, and deliverables; and help shape practical solutions that achieve committed client outcomes.

As a team member, you'll be part of a Chemicals & Natural Resources industry team focused on applying cybersecurity expertise across the CNR value chain — from upstream exploration and extraction, to refining, processing, and distribution, through to chemical manufacturing and end-product delivery. You'll work closely with our CNR industry leaders to innovate and shape secure, resilient solutions for operational technology modernization, supply chain security, and industrial process safety.

* **Client Engagement:** Build trusted working relationships with chemical, oil & gas, mining, and agricultural client stakeholders, translating their cybersecurity, safety, regulatory, and operational resilience priorities into actionable workplans and deliverables.
* **Initiative Delivery:** Manage cybersecurity workstreams and project teams delivering solutions across cyber defense, AI-enabled security, risk management, and compliance, aligned with client objectives, scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
* **CNR Insight & Strategy Development:** Apply deep knowledge of CNR operations, regulatory obligations, threat trends, and technology modernization to shape practical client strategies tailored to chemical, energy, and natural resource environments.
* **Innovative Strategy Formulation:** Collaborate with CNR clients to create and implement forward-looking strategies that secure operational technology modernization, process control systems, supply chain digitization, cloud adoption, and IT/OT convergence while protecting worker safety, environmental compliance, and operational continuity.
* **Secure AI:** Support CNR clients in the secure adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning across industrial operations — including AI-driven process optimization, predictive maintenance, and autonomous systems — ensuring AI deployments are implemented with security, safety, and governance controls embedded from inception.
* **Team Leadership & Development:** Supervise and coach project team members, assign work, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing delivery environment.
* **Communication & Reporting:** Develop clear recommendations, status reports, and executive-ready materials; present findings and delivery progress to client and Accenture stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to align security initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cybersecurity assessments, strategy workstreams, and implementation activities across CNR enterprise and operational environments, including IT, OT/ICS, cloud, process control networks, distributed control systems (DCS), SCADA, historian systems, and manufacturing execution systems (MES), while supporting applicable requirements such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-82, EPA Risk Management Program, TSA Security Directives, CIRCIA, API 1164, and industry-specific HSE regulations.
* Support senior leaders in advising CNR stakeholders on integrating cybersecurity risk management into operational resilience, capital programs, plant modernization, emergency preparedness, and sustainability initiatives.
* Manage CNR cybersecurity transformation workstreams focused on secure IT/OT convergence, network segmentation, internal network security monitoring, threat detection modernization, cyber resilience, and identity and access management for critical industrial infrastructure.
* Facilitate CNR-specific threat modeling, incident response, and recovery-readiness activities for risks such as ransomware, nation-state activity, supply chain compromise, insecure remote access, and attacks affecting chemical plants, ref

Company:

Everest Global Services, Inc.

Job Category:

Human Resources

Job Description:

**About Everest:**

Everest is a global leader in risk management, rooted in a rich, 50+ year heritage of enabling businesses to survive and thrive, and economies to function and flourish. We are underwriters of risk, growth, progress and opportunity. We are a global team focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders, who care deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world.

**About the Role:**

We are currently looking for an HR Project Manager based in our Warren, New Jersey headquarters to support a portfolio of strategic HR initiatives and technical HRIS projects. Reporting to the Head of Global People Services, this role will partner closely with HR, HRIS, IT, Talent, People Analytics, and other business stakeholders to plan, manage, and deliver projects that improve HR operations, enhance employee and manager experiences, and support Everest’s broader HR transformation agenda.

This position will be a hybrid schedule of working three days in office and two days remote each week.

**Who You Are**

You are a hands-on project manager who can move comfortably between business strategy and HR technology execution. You have experience managing complex, cross-functional projects, translating business needs into clear project plans, and driving work forward through structure, follow-up, and strong stakeholder partnership.

You bring strong execution discipline, sound judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority. You can manage project scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, communications, and change impacts while keeping leaders and project teams aligned. You are comfortable supporting both strategic HR programs and more technical HRIS projects, including work that may involve process design, data, system enhancements, testing, configurations, and adoption.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage a portfolio of HR strategic initiatives and HRIS projects from planning through execution, ensuring scope, milestones, deliverables, risks, and decisions are clearly defined and actively managed.

* Partner with HR, HRIS, IT, People Analytics, Talent, business leaders, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable project plans and clear workstreams.

* Support technical HRIS projects by coordinating requirements, design discussions, testing activities, issue resolution, launch readiness, communications, and post-implementation follow-up.

* Drive project governance, including status reporting, meeting agendas, decision logs, risk and issue tracking, stakeholder updates, and escalation of key dependencies.

* Create clear, polished project materials for leadership, including presentations, project plans, timelines, dashboards, summaries, and recommendations.

* Identify process improvement opportunities and help design practical solutions that simplify work, improve controls, reduce manual effort, and strengthen the employee and manager experience.

* Lead through influence, building trust with stakeholders and keeping teams focused, organized, and accountable for outcomes.

Support change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training coordination, readiness planning, and adoption tracking.  



**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

* 5+ years of project management experience, ideally supporting HR, HR transformation, HR shared services, HR operations, HRIS, or enterprise technology initiatives.

* Experience managing projects involving HR systems, process improvement, data, reporting, workflow design, testing, configurations, or system enhancements; Workday experience strongly preferred.

* Strong understanding of project management fundamentals, including planning, governance, stakeholder management, risk management, dependency tracking, and delivery execution.

* Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels, moving from high-level planning to detailed execution as needed.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations, project updates, and leadership-ready materials.

* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for senior leaders, project teams, technical partners, and operational stakeholders.

* Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with project management tools and Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies preferred.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet commitments, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, global environment.

* Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making capabilities, with a focus on practical, outcomes-oriented solutions.

* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, including the ability to manage project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams.

Strong relationship-building and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across HR, IT, business teams, and external partners.  

  
  

The base salary range for this position is $102,000 - $124,000 annually. The offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, experience, qualifications and work location. All offers include access to a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, 401k match, retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 389421
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Project Manager - PMO to join our team in Jersey City, New Jersey (US-NJ), United States (US).
  
  
Day to Day Job Duties
  

* Perform hands-on PMO activities supporting banking technology and transformation programs. This is a hands-on delivery role and requires the individual to personally own and execute PMO activities rather than only provide oversight or coordination.
* Work closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to track project plans, sprint commitments, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Prepare and maintain weekly project status reports, dashboards, management presentations, and executive-level reporting.
* Own and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Actions, Issues and Dependencies), proactively following up with owners and escalating items requiring management attention.
* Coordinate and support project governance forums, Steering Committee meetings, program reviews, and working-group meetings, including preparation of agendas, presentations, meeting minutes, decisions, and action tracking.
* Support delivery in an Agile environment, participating in relevant Agile ceremonies and working closely with Scrum teams to track delivery progress, impediments, dependencies, and commitments.
* Consolidate information from multiple workstreams and provide a clear view of overall program status, key risks, upcoming milestones, and areas requiring attention.
* Perform hands-on tracking of project financials including budgets, forecasts, actuals, resource costs, and variances.
* Track resource requirements, onboarding/offboarding, allocation, utilization, and capacity across project teams.
* Maintain project plans, governance artifacts, documentation repositories, change requests, decision logs, and other required PMO documentation.
* Work with business, technology, operations, vendors, and other stakeholders to drive closure of actions and ensure delivery commitments are met.
* Identify gaps in project governance or execution and proactively work with the project leadership team to address them.
* Support continuous improvement of PMO processes, templates, governance standards, and reporting practices.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Manufacturing PMO
jobs.description:
At Crestron Electronics, Inc we build the technology that integrates technology.
  
  
We are proud to be the largest and most recognized brand in automation and control solutions, and the premier technology partner for fortune 500 businesses globally. Our products’ are integrated into new high-tech commercial buildings’ to include some of the most exciting real estate throughout the world. Our clients include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, LinkedIn and many others. We are the leaders in the most exciting industry in the world!
  
Our automation and control solutions for homes and buildings allow our clients to control entire environments with the push of a button, integrating systems such as Audio Visual, Lighting, Shading, Security, Building Management Systems and HVAC to provide greater comfort, convenience and security.
  
  
The Sr. Project Manager – Manufacturing PMO is responsible for leading the transition of new products from Engineering into Production, serving as the primary manufacturing and supply chain project management interface between Engineering and Operations. This role owns planning and execution of multiple New Product Introduction (NPI) projects, ensuring manufacturing readiness, supplier alignment, and successful product launches.
  
  
Partnering closely with Design Engineering Project Managers, the Manufacturing PM develops integrated project plans that incorporate manufacturing strategy, supplier readiness, cost targets, and production risk mitigation early in the development lifecycle. The role works cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Contract Manufacturers, and internal manufacturing teams to coordinate builds, validate readiness, and execute production ramps and transfers.
  
  
Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this position drives execution across internal and external organizations, proactively identifying risks, resolving schedule and resource conflicts, and holding teams accountable to deliverables. The Project Manager brings strong project management discipline, clear communication, and the ability to translate technical and supply chain complexity into actionable plans and concise stakeholder updates.
  
The position requires knowledge of project management methodologies, manufacturing NPI processes, and supply/demand requirements. It requires the ability to translate technical and supply chain complexity into clear, actionable plans and executive-level communication. The Project Manager plays a critical role in manufacturing execution supporting NPI delivery.
  
Strong knowledge of Project Management Processes, PMBOK, and project planning are essential. Strong computer skills in MS Project and MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio) are required.
  
\*\*\* This role is Hybrid and candidates must be local to our New Jersey office.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Monitor and control projects (identify/monitor risks, hold project status meetings with cross functional teams to monitor deliverables, resolve conflicts, manage priorities, resources, and issues, manage scope/changes, update project plans as necessary)
* Create project plans for manufacturing process and support of NPI products (plan deliverables, create schedule baseline, manage dependencies)
* Manage prototype builds in production, host product reviews with Engineering and Operations, assign and manage action items
* Create procurement plans, manage custom designed part FAI approvals, identify and manage long lead parts to be ready for prototype and production builds.
* Coordinate launch plans for internal direct launches at Orangeburg factory, direct launches or transfer of products to contract manufacturers, host Launch Readiness Reviews with all stakeholders.
* Review product roadmaps with Engineering PMO and Product Management, identify product discontinuations, replacement products, work with supply chain to plan demand changes.

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering
* 5 - 8 years experience in Project Management, ability to lead multiple large scale projects simultaneously
* Strong Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Power BI skills
* Strong Project Management process skills
* Strong data analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills
* Teamwork, communication and interpersonal skills
* Enterprise resource planning skills (SAP a plus)

Per applicable state requirements, the annual pay range for this position ($91,500 - $131,000) which consists of base salary (subject to performance), reflects the hiring range for candidates. Also note, an individual’s offer may vary from this range as it may be impacted by additional factors, including but not limited to the candidate's hiring location, qualifications, experience, and market factors.
  
  
Crestron Electronics offers a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, 401K with company match, Paid Time Off, Holidays, On-site Amenities at NJ Headquarters & TX Facilities, Crestron Market Cafes, and Fitness Centers.
  
  
At Crestron Electronics, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion drive innovation. Crestron’s success hinges on continuing to build a workforce of unique individuals whose passion inspires us to create and revolutionize industry-leading products and services. There will always be more to accomplish, and at Crestron, we believe the best way forward is together.
  
  
EOE/M/F/D/V
  
  

* No Solicitation\* Any agency submittal to any employee of Crestron Electronics, Inc by any method of communication will be deemed the sole property of Crestron Electronics Inc.

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

**Position Summary**

The Business Operations role is a member of the Facilities & Administration team responsible for helping develop and establish the tools, systems, processes, reporting routines, and operating cadence needed to implement department initiatives and strategic priorities across facilities operations, infrastructure management, and facilities capital planning for the NBA’s New York and New Jersey offices. This role helps translate department objectives into organized workplans, standardized workflows, clear measures of progress, and practical coordination mechanisms that improve visibility, accountability, and execution across the team.

Working cross-functionally with Finance, Procurement, Legal, IT, Security, Human Resources, Corporate Services, property management, consultants, and third-party vendors, the role monitors, measures, and reports on department workstreams while providing administrative coordination and procurement support for vendors and services that enable facilities operations, infrastructure management, and facilities capital planning. The position supports sourcing documentation, purchase order workflows, contract and commitment tracking, vendor documentation, reporting, and follow-up needed to keep department initiatives organized, measurable, and moving forward.

* Lead the development, implementation, and adoption of technology-enabled and AI-enabled tools, workflows, dashboards, and reporting routines that improve department efficiency, strengthen decision-making, and support consistent execution across facilities operations, infrastructure management, and capital planning.

CIE Program Manager

Bachelor’s degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Four (4) years of directly related full-time administrative experience. Experience working with college students. Experience planning and executing events. Experience managing programs or projects. Experience with Microsoft Office Suite and/or Google applications.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Advanced degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Experience working with graduate students. Experience working with international students. Experience promoting equity and inclusion in academic environments. Experience developing and managing budgets. Experience collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to inform program decisions. Experience cultivating and maintaining productive collaborations with internal and external stakeholders. Experience developing and presenting professional communications to varied audiences. Experience using productivity and operations tools (e.g., Qualtrics [survey design], Concur [travel and expense management], and SBU Reporting [institutional reporting] or similar platforms).

jobs.title: Program Manager, Inventory Strategy and Ops
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

Compass International Holdings is seeking a Lead, Inventory Product, Data & Ops to make sure our inventory products work as promised across all ten brands, and to rebuild how that work gets done with AI.

You will report to the Director, Inventory Product, Data & Ops. This team owns the technical and operational backbone of listing distribution: when a listing moves from an agent to the MLS, our agent platform, our brand websites, and portals, we make sure it happens correctly, on time, and per the seller's instructions. The Director sets roadmap priorities and MLS strategy. You own the operating engine underneath it: testing and validating what ships, helping build the AI systems that run our daily processes, keeping our reporting accurate, and keeping every workstream documented, tracked, and organized.

This is a hybrid seat. You understand the business well enough to know what matters to an agent and a seller, and the technology well enough to sit with Product and Engineering, read a spec, and see where it will break. You are AI-first by default. Not someone who only uses AI to move faster on their own work, but someone who builds, stress tests, and deploys AI systems.

Every inventory program Compass International Holdings runs depends on the product doing what we told agents and clients it would do. This role is how we know it does. It is also how a small team operates at national scale: by letting AI run the work that used to take people, and freeing leadership to focus on where the product and the MLS landscape go next.

**At Compass You Will**
-----------------------

* Own day-to-day execution of QA testing and quality validation (including secret shopping) for inventory products across the MLS, agent platform, brand websites, and portals

* Coordinate offshore testing teams: scope the work, write clear test instructions, set turnaround expectations, and review output against a quality bar
* Partner with Product and Engineering as new features approach release; read requirements, map the scenarios and edge cases that need coverage (by brand, market, MLS rule set, listing status, and seller instruction), and get tests designed before launch rather than after
* Organize test readouts: synthesize results, prioritize defects by business impact, and bring a clear recommendation to the Director, Product, and brand stakeholders
* Track defects to resolution and confirm fixes in production through regression testing
* Apply AI to testing itself, from generating scenario coverage off a requirements doc to automating repeatable checks and secret shopping
* Support technical readiness for new launches by validating that products work as expected before they reach agents

### **Documentation, Tracking & Organization**

* Be the team's system of record: keep test plans, results, defects, automations, SOPs, and decisions documented, current, and easy to find
* Build and maintain the trackers the team runs on (testing cycles, automation builds, open issues, requests, and cross-functional commitments) so status is always visible without anyone having to ask
* Organize every cross-functional interaction with Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, offshore teams, and brand stakeholders: notes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates, with follow-through until each item is closed
* Document every automation so others can understand, audit, maintain, and improve it
* Keep a clean record of product behavior, known issues, and MLS rule interpretations so answers never live in one person's head
* Set documentation and tracking standards for the team, so the Director and partners can get full context fast

### **AI Automation & Process Rebuild**

* Help build, test, and deploy AI automations for the processes the Director and team have prioritized, so AI owns the work end to end and people review exceptions
* Prototype quickly by vibe coding, then stress test before anything goes live: edge cases, bad inputs, volume, and failure scenarios
* Harden prototypes into systems that run daily in production, not one-off scripts or personal tools
* Set up monitoring for each automation: expected outputs, accuracy checks, error handling, alerting, and a clear escalation path when something fails
* Measure each automation's impact in hours returned, error rates, and turnaround time
* Build governance in from the start: partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Security so every automation respects MLS data licensing terms, seller privacy and instructions, and Fair Housing requirements, and keeps an audit trail of what it did
* Train support, brand-facing, and operations teams on each new workflow before it launches, with walkthroughs, quick-reference guides, and office hours

* Test and validate report and dashboard outputs before they are used for decisions, and trace discrepancies between systems (MLS feeds, agent platform, brand websites, portals) to root cause
* Monitor progress to goal on inventory metrics and flag risks to the Director early

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

We are looking for a high-impact Legal Operations Program Manager to join our expanding Legal Operations Team and sit at the center of our mergers & acquisitions (M&A) activity! This is a strategy-to-execution role focused on post-acquisition integration: bringing acquired companies' legal teams, legal entities, contracts, litigation and matters, outside counsel relationships, and compliance obligations into the Lyft Legal organization. To be clear, this is a business and organizational M&A integration role, not a systems or technology integration role. You will serve as the operating backbone for Legal across our most strategic transactions, owning the legal workstream of M&A integration in partnership with Lyft's Corporate Development Integration Management Office (IMO), along with the intake and governance layer that connects the Legal team to deal work. jobs.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

The Data Protection Security Investigations Analyst 2 works with EIP stakeholders and Humana’s teams to identify high risk insider activity and ensure appropriate controls are in place to mitigate potential data loss or malicious activity. Understands department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas. Makes decisions regarding own work methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations, and requires minimal direction and receives guidance where needed. Follows established guidelines/procedures.

The Data Protection Investigations Analyst (P2) supports enterprise Data Protection Operations through level two alert triage, investigation support, evidence review, and stakeholder coordination. The analyst evaluates alerts, logs, user activity, system indicators, and related evidence to identify potential data exposure, unauthorized movement, policy violations, and insider risk.

The analyst partners with Enterprise Information Protection, Humana Resources, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and business teams on investigations, security reviews, control questions, and evidence requests. The role strengthens Data Protection Operations through accurate case documentation, disciplined queue management, evidence organization, process improvement, and consistent execution.

A key focus is providing enterprise-aligned support to subsidiaries and affiliated businesses while maintaining consistent investigation, evidence-handling, documentation, escalation, privacy, and compliance standards.

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================
