### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program.

Our Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Policy Analyst (FMS Program Analyst), Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.

You will be part of a dynamic team of F-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F-35 systems.

In this role, you will:

* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with FMS Program Managers to advise and support country teams in the areas of policy, case development, and case execution.
* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.
* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105.65-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* The ability to provide onsite support at the F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
  + OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000.2 (Operation of the Defense Acquisition System), DoD Directive (DODD) 5530.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105.38-MX.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Center Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Data Center Design Engineering team.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The ideal candidate should thrive in ambiguity and competing priorities. Be an exceptionally strong communicator both written and verbally who can translate complex technical schedules into clear executive narratives. Possess a strong sense of organization, accountability, and team building that fosters robust working relationships across internal and external stakeholders. Are comfortable managing remote delivery teams and can navigate mechanical/electrical engineering concepts with confidence. Are relentless about on-time delivery and treat every missed milestone as a learning opportunity to improve the system.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to gain insights and capture critical mechanical, electrical and utility needs for the business today and in the future
* Utilize those insights to identify specific program requirements, create a program vision, and own the product development roadmap for critical segments of the data center physical infrastructure
* Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
* Drive continuous advancements and improvements within our data center designs, and communicate technical solutions to Senior Management
* Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide scale deployment to eventual deprecation
* Develop product features and deployment strategies to improve performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency of new applications and use cases
* Communicate complex issues clearly and effectively to leadership to propose solutions and fully inform risk decisions
* Work independently in a high-performing environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist

  
About the team  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience managing data center and/or mission critical facility design projects
* 5+ years of data center infrastructure experience including capacity planning, design, construction, or operations

jobs.description:
Description:

Markon is seeking a Technical Operations Project Manager to support an Intelligence Community client in Chantilly, Virginia. The Technical Operations PM will serve as the primary technical point of contact for the Project Team, providing technical guidance, coordinating requirements, and overseeing solutions as customer communications needs evolve.

Responsibilities:

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a designated Project Team and its communications solution suite.
* Manage and track customer technical solutions throughout the lifecycle, from requirements gathering and development through implementation and operations and maintenance (O&M).
* Gather and document technical requirements and coordinate them with customers, stakeholders, and development teams.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and maintain communication across technical and mission teams.
* Provide technical guidance and oversight to ensure communications solutions address evolving mission requirements.
* Support the design, configuration, deployment, and sustainment of robust and scalable IT solutions.
* Coordinate with development teams to track and validate technical requirements.
* Apply IT and cybersecurity best practices throughout solution development and implementation.
* Support networking, network security, virtualization, and associated infrastructure technologies.
* Support the implementation and sustainment of Virtual Desktop technologies.
* Train system users on newly implemented technical solutions and capabilities.
* Present technical operations, project status, risks, and recommendations to senior management.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* An Active TS/SCI with a FSP (preferrably from this client) is required to be considered.
* Bachelor’s degree in a field related to the technical function and at least 11 years of relevant experience developing robust, scalable IT solutions, with an emphasis on virtualization platforms and associated infrastructure; OR
  + Associate’s degree and at least 13 years of related experience; OR
  + No degree and at least 15 years of related experience.
* Demonstrated experience with requirements gathering, stakeholder management, solution configuration and deployment, and user training.
* Experience managing technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, including requirements, implementation, and O&M.
* Experience implementing IT and cybersecurity best practices and working with networking and network security technologies.
* Experience with Virtual Desktop technologies.
* Experience working with development teams to track and validate technical requirements.
* Ability to present and discuss technical operations effectively with senior management.

**Desired:**

* Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
* Hands-on experience with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and designing, building, deploying, or maintaining networks.
* Recent hands-on experience (within the last 3 years) with WAN, LAN, and client-access technologies such as MACsec, HSRP, VRF, VPC, ACLs, BGP, and EIGRP.
* Understanding of security monitoring and auditing, including experience guiding systems through the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) process.
* Hands-on experience with commercial cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Experience with commercial voice technologies such as VoIP and PBX.

Salary Range: USD $170,000.00 - USD $200,000.00 /Yr.  
  
The Markon pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Eager to join a team where your skills are valued, your growth is nurtured, and your impact is profound? Look no further than Markon, a premier consulting firm deeply dedicated to advancing our nation's most critical missions.

At Markon, we don't just offer jobs – we offer opportunities for personal and professional transformation. Empowering our employees to lead, innovate, and excel, we foster an environment where new ideas are not just welcomed but celebrated. As a perennial Washington Post Top Workplace, we prioritize the well-being and success of our team members, ensuring they can bring their best selves to work.

Headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, Markon has garnered national recognition for our unwavering dedication to excellence in serving the intelligence community, as well as federal civilian and defense agencies. Our growing reach extends across 17 states, 116 countries, and 5 continents, where our team of dynamic professionals collaborates to deliver unparalleled program and project management services.

Markon values people and the tremendous impact each individual can make – which is why we’re consistently recognized as one of the best places to work in federal government consulting. Here, you can help solve the nation’s most important challenges, surrounded by colleagues who help you grow, advance, and succeed. We are deeply dedicated to what matters – bringing out the best in each other to advance our clients’ missions.  
  
Join us and make a meaningful impact.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Background**

Every donation processed, every campaign that lands, every supporter who stays engaged — that's the technology you'll help build and deliver.

As **IT Program Manager**, you'll manage the digital platforms behind one of the world's leading humanitarian organizations, directly enabling the fundraising that funds life-saving programs for displaced communities across the globe. This is a high-impact, fast-paced role at the intersection of technology delivery, stakeholder engagement, and mission-driven purpose.

You'll be a core member of our Project Management team, working across a modern MarTech ecosystem — including donation and e-commerce platforms **(Fundraise Up, Springboard)**, our website **(Drupal)**, **Salesforce CRM**, **Databricks**, email marketing **(Pardot)**, and SMS platforms **(Mobile Commons, Mogli)**. You'll own the delivery of enhancements, integrations, and new capability launches that keep the IRC's digital supporter experience best-in-class.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real-world impact** — your work directly supports humanitarian programs serving millions of people in crisis.
* **Breadth and ownership** — lead a complex, multi-platform portfolio with genuine strategic influence from day one.
* **Collaborative culture** — work alongside Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders in a distributed, multicultural team that's deeply committed to its mission.
* **Modern delivery** — Agile/Scrum at the core, with room to shape how the team works.
* **Remote-first flexibility** — work from anywhere in the US as part of a truly global organization.

**What You'll Do**

**Drive end-to-end program delivery** Own the full lifecycle of multiple concurrent MarTech initiatives — from scope definition and roadmap planning through to launch and post-delivery review. Develop and maintain detailed project plans, work breakdown structures, and product backlogs, ensuring delivery against time, budget, and quality targets.

**Champion Agile ways of working** Serve as Scrum Master for your project and product teams — coaching on Agile principles, facilitating sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and reviews, and proactively removing blockers to keep delivery on track.

**Keep stakeholders informed and aligned** Prepare clear, timely status reports covering scope, milestones, risks, and budget. Communicate confidently with audiences from engineers to senior executives, tailoring your message appropriately. Manage expectations and build trust across business and technology teams.

**Manage budgets and vendors** Oversee budget tracking and vendor invoicing for your portfolio. Support cost estimation, validate expenditure, and contribute to the annual budget planning process to ensure initiatives are delivered within financial targets.

**Lead business analysis activities** Work with the team to define and track functional and technical requirements, document current and future state processes, and coordinate testing activities. Partner closely with Business Analysts to ensure delivery is grounded in well-understood business needs.

**Manage risk proactively** Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans. Surface issues early, escalate where needed, and keep the project leadership team ahead of potential blockers.

**Shape the roadmap** Partner with Product Managers to build out product and project roadmaps that reflect both business priorities and technical realities, contributing to a coherent long-term vision for the MarTech portfolio.

**What You'll Bring**

**You'll need:**

* 3-6 years of experience in IT project or program management, ideally across e-commerce systems, donation platforms, website CMS, or other Marketing Technology.
* A strong track record of delivering multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget.
* Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, or similar).
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills - comfortable engaging with variety of project collaborators from developers to executives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize data and drive decision-making.
* High levels of organization, initiative, and the ability to work independently in a distributed and fast-paced environment.

**It'd be great if you have:**

* Experience with any of the platforms in scope: Fundraise Up, Springboard, Drupal, Salesforce, Pardot, Databricks.
* Familiarity with non-profit fundraising, digital marketing, or supporter engagement processes.
* Experience managing third-party vendors and project budgets.
* Knowledge of SDLC methodologies (Waterfall and Agile).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio for producing high-quality project artifacts.

**Bonus points for:**

* A PMP, CSM, CSPO, or SAFe certification.
* Experience working in international development, human rights, or a related field.
* An understanding of payment processing platforms (Stripe, PayPal, etc.).

**Benefits and Working Environment**

* Standard office working environment.
* Currently the team is working in a hybrid model with one day

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Mainframe Product Migration
jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 390892
  
  
**Competitive salary | UK:** hybrid: Sheffield OR London + remote
  
  
At NTT DATA, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. The quality, integrity, and commitment of our employees are key factors in our company’s growth, market presence and our ability to help our clients stay a step ahead of the competition. By hiring the best people and helping them grow both professionally and personally, we ensure a bright future for NTT DATA and for the people who work here.
  
  
NTT DATA is currently looking for an Implementation Manager - Mainframe Product Migration on a hybrid work model (Sheffield or London + remote) for our growing team in the UK.
  
  
**Role purpose:** Plan, coordinate, and execute the end-to-end implementation of a Mainframe Product Migration into production, ensuring a controlled, compliant, and low-risk cutover. Own the integrated deployment/cutover plan, readiness, and go/no-go governance across technology, operations, business, and third parties.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  

* Create and maintain the integrated implementation (deployment/cutover) strategy and plan covering scope, approach (big bang/phased), timeline, dependencies, and critical path.
* Lead cutover planning: detailed runbooks, rehearsal plans, roles/responsibilities, communications, checkpoints, and contingency/rollback.
* Coordinate release and change management activities (CAB submissions, implementation approvals, change records, stakeholder signoffs).
* Drive environment and operational readiness: capacity, access, monitoring, scheduling/batch windows, support model, service transition.
* Manage data migration implementation activities with clear sequencing, validation steps, reconciliation, and operational controls.
* Orchestrate dress rehearsals / mock cutovers, capture lessons learned and harden runbooks.
* Lead implementation governance: readiness reviews, RAID management, decision logs, and executive reporting.
* Coordinate hyper care/post-go-live: incident triage, defect backlog prioritisation, stabilisation metrics, and handover to BAU.
* Ensure alignment with risk/compliance/audit requirements (evidence packs, approvals, segregation of duties where required).
* Manage third parties/vendors involved in deployment (e.g., infrastructure, platform, data, app support, schedulers).

Deliverables (typical)
  

* Implementation strategy and Integrated Cutover Plan
* Detailed cutover runbooks (minute-by-minute where needed)
* Rehearsal plans and rehearsal outcomes/actions log
* Change/CAB artefacts and approval pack
* Readiness criteria, go/no-go checklist, and decision log
* Hypercare plan, support model, and BAU handover pack
* Implementation closure report and lessons learned

Required experience
  

* Proven Implementation/Cutover/Deployment Management on mainframe or large-scale legacy migrations.
* Strong understanding of z/OS production operations constraints: batch cycles (JCL), scheduling (e.g., Control-M/CA-7), DB2/IMS considerations, CICS regions, interface dependencies, and resilience/DR practices.
* Experience running dress rehearsals, coordinating cross-team cutovers, and leading go/no-go forums.
* Working knowledge of ITIL-aligned change, release, and incident management in regulated environments.

Key skills behaviours
  

* Excellent planning and dependency management; strong “get it done” execution bias.
* Clear, calm leadership during high-pressure cutover windows.
* Strong stakeholder management across technology, operations, business, risk/compliance, and suppliers.
* Crisp written communication: executive updates, RAID, and runbook clarity.

Tools/skills
  

* Planning: MS Project/Smartsheet/Jira/Confluence
* Change/ITSM: ServiceNow (or equivalent)
* Reporting: Excel

Benefits
  
  
Our people are the most critical component of our long-term success and their health and wellbeing are our priority. You will enjoy a comprehensive, locally competitive benefits package.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. JIRA Analyst – Regulatory Reporting Group

  

Job Description: 12-month fixed-term contract

  

**Customer**

  

* Act as the primary bridge between the Regulatory Reporting Group (RRG) and Technology for the management and progression of JIRA items.
* Host bi-weekly stakeholder calls to review JIRA progress, resolve blockers and confirm readiness for upcoming monthly release cycles.
Coordinate with RRG, Technology and Compliance to maintain clear ownership, actions and delivery dates for priority JIRA items.  

  

**Shareholder**

  

* Confirm the monthly priority JIRA population with Compliance, ensuring agreed priorities are documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Produce accurate management metrics and reporting on JIRA volumes, status, ageing, priority, delivery progress, blockers and upcoming release milestones.
* Review JIRA records to ensure each item is assigned to the correct risk category and contains sufficient information to support prioritisation and governance
Ensure sustained focus on risk-sensitive and aged JIRA items, escalating delays, control concerns and delivery risks through the appropriate governance channels.  

  

**Employee/Team**

  

* Build effective working relationships across RRG, Technology, Compliance and other stakeholders involved in JIRA delivery.
Communicate JIRA status, priorities, risks and required decisions clearly and concisely to management and wider stakeholder groups.  

  

**Breadth & Depth**

  

* Strong working knowledge of JIRA
* Understanding of regulatory reporting operations, technology delivery lifecycles and the governance required to manage changes into monthly releases.
* Ability to analyse JIRA data, identify trends and exceptions, and translate findings into clear management information and actionable follow-ups.
Strong organisational and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to challenge priorities, drive actions and escalate delivery risks appropriately.  

  

Experience and/or Education

  

* Undergraduate degree, college diploma or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, operations, change delivery, governance or regulatory reporting.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Technical Program Manager, Interconnect Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global AWS network. It is dedicated to facilitating the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is also responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between Data Centers and customers.  
  
The Interconnect team is responsible for delivering the interconnect capacity connecting the Amazon network to the internet.  
The Interconnect TIPM will support the Interconnect Business Developers (BDs) to ensure that this delivery of capacity is friction-less to both internal and external networks. One form of this capacity is the use of embedded caches which are deployed with ISPs' networks.
  
  
The role of the TIPM includes supporting the coordination and project management with those external ISPs for the deployment of caches. The TIPM is expected to anticipate issues or problems with the wide-scale global deployment of embedded caches with ISPs, including supply-chain, logistics, installation, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, reporting, tools and operations. The TIPM is expected to find opportunities for process improvements and introduction of new tools or automation.  
If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we’d love for you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks.  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce, we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you would like to request an accommodation for the interview or onboarding process, please let us know and we will connect you to our accommodation team. You may also reach them directly by visiting https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/us  
  
Mentorship and Career growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Working at AWS the GCNA Team - Meet Robert, VP: https://youtu.be/8v5i42FL02w
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own embedded caching deployments from time of contract signing until completed CloudFront provisioning.
* Liaise with ISP and site contacts to gather and validate site information to enable expedient and accurate handoff to CloudFront.
* Manage deployments of multiple caches with ISPs to ensure efficiency and reduce repetition of asks. This aligns with the common approach ISPs take when deploying multiple caches of having a single PM managing all sites.
* Partake in troubleshooting with ISPs / colocation / cross connect providers when installs are not successful the first time.
* Assist CloudFront with break/fix and ISP communications as needed.
* Establish or improve on documentation and reporting.
* Work on continual embedded caching deployment process improvement in conjunction with CloudFront. This includes the development of new tools, new forms of reporting or new processes and workflows.

  
About the team  
Amazon connects its global network to numerous external networks to deliver content and services to customers worldwide. This connectivity comes in two forms: direct peering with destination networks or transit through intermediary networks.  
  
The AGIS team manages all external network relationships, securing connectivity in optimal locations. Peering arrangements are either settlement-free (SFI) or paid, with most being SFI. When necessary, the team conducts commercial negotiations to acquire paid peering or transit capacity.  
  
Additionally, AGIS negotiates embedded caching contracts, deploying caching platforms within external networks to enhance content delivery and performance.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in a procurement organization performing vendor management, contract management, negotiating complex purchases, and bidding
* Experience managing competing priorities and using metrics to drive business decisions
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
* Experience in Technical Infrastructure Management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

### **Role**

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is a global investment management firm entrusted by investors worldwide to help navigate evolving market conditions and achieve their long-term investment objectives.

Reporting to the EMEA Chief Operating Officer, the Senior Project Manager will lead and deliver strategic business transformation initiatives across the Asset Management business. Sitting within the global Platform Innovation function, the role is responsible for driving complex, high-impact programmes from concept through implementation, accelerating NTAM's strategic priorities and competitive advantage.

Project Manager

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**  
We’re looking for a delivery-focused Project Manager who can independently manage business change projects and deliver clear, sustainable outcomes across PL Re.

You will bring structure, control and momentum to delivery through disciplined planning, effective governance, sound financial management and proactive oversight of scope, risks, issues and dependencies. Working closely with sponsors, stakeholders and delivery teams, you will create clarity, support timely decisions and ensure that business readiness, adoption and benefits remain central throughout the project lifecycle.

jobs.title: Financial Crime Implementation Project Manager / Workstream Lead
jobs.description:
We're partnering with a leading financial services organisation as it begins a multi-year financial crime transformation programme, centred on implementing Fenergo as its client lifecycle management platform.

This is a delivery leadership role. You will own the financial crime implementation workstream, responsible for planning, governing and landing change across KYC, onboarding, periodic review and screening. You will also make sure the Fenergo platform is embedded successfully across the business.

The work is delivery-led. You will manage a team of analysts and subject matter experts, coordinate with the vendor, systems integrators and internal technology teams, and manage dependencies across the wider programme. Because the programme is regulatory-driven, delivery needs to stay aligned to policy and regulatory expectations throughout, and to stand up to scrutiny from compliance, audit and senior governance forums.

The role suits an experienced project manager or workstream lead from a financial crime or CLM transformation background. You should pair delivery discipline with the presence to lead steering committees and influence senior stakeholders. This is an initial 6-month engagement, with a strong likelihood of extension to two years as the programme progresses. It is based in London, with three days per week on site, and is expected to start as soon as possible.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of the financial crime implementation workstream, including planning, scope, budget and RAID management.
* Oversee the implementation of Fenergo, working closely with the vendor, systems integrators and internal technology teams.
* Drive the design and rollout of target operating model changes across KYC, onboarding, periodic review and screening.
* Manage dependencies across the wider transformation programme, including the data, migration and integration workstreams.
* Lead and develop a team of business analysts, subject matter experts and delivery resources.
* Run workstream governance and give clear, concise reporting to steering committees and senior stakeholders.
* Keep delivery aligned to regulatory obligations, internal policy and audit expectations.
* Oversee testing, business readiness and implementation planning so the transition into BAU is controlled.

  
**Requirements**  

* Significant experience leading financial crime, KYC or client lifecycle management change programmes in financial services.
* Demonstrable experience delivering a Fenergo implementation, ideally in a leadership role.
* A strong understanding of the AML and KYC regulatory landscape, including the UK Money Laundering Regulations, JMLSG guidance and FCA expectations.
* A proven ability to manage complex workstreams with multiple dependencies, vendors and stakeholders.
* Experience leading and developing delivery teams.
* The credibility to present to, and influence, senior stakeholders and steering committees.
* A strong command of programme governance, financial management and risk management.
* A recognised project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, MSP, PMP or an Agile equivalent) is an advantage.

  
**Benefits**

Length: Initial 6-month contract, with likely extension to two years  
Salary: £90,000–£120,000, dependent on experience

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst – Labour & Productivity
jobs.description:
**The Role..**

We are starting a labour optimisation programme with our Operations team, alongside FP&A and Data Science. The aim is to improve our wage percentage to sales while improving service standards at the same time. We are not interested in an approach that delivers one at the expense of the other.

We are currently selecting an advanced scheduling platform to support this. The analytical foundation underneath it,how we measure productivity, what our labour standards are, how good our demand forecasts need to be - is what this role owns.

You will sit in the Data team and work in close partnership with FP&A. Analysis alone will not move the number; changes stick when a Finance Business Partner and a General Manager can see the opportunity in their own House, agree the size of it and hold it in their forecast. Your job is to give them that, in a form they can act on.

**Key Responsibilities..**

* Labour productivity analysis, identifying site-by-site opportunities for efficiency gains and sizing each one
* Work with Operations and Finance to trial changes to scheduling and measure their impact
* Build improved labour reporting, so Business Partners and GMs can see productivity, schedule changes and shift adherence on a daily and weekly cadence
* Support Finance translate demand forecasts into labour requirements, helping to build the models that turn covers, check-ins, treatments and occupancy into hours by role
* Partner with our Data Science and Operations teams to understand forecast accuracy and recommend improvements
* Connect labour deployment to member experience, so that productivity gains are demonstrably not coming out of the House

What we are looking for..

* Proven experience in labour optimisation. You have personally delivered measurable improvement in wage percentage or sales per labour hour in a multi-site operation, and can talk us through the levers you pulled, how you sized them and how you proved the result
* A track record of partnering finance and operational stakeholders to land change, not just report on it

jobs.title: Financial Crime Implementation Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We're partnering with a leading financial services organisation as it begins a multi-year financial crime transformation programme, centred on implementing Fenergo as its client lifecycle management platform.

This is a hands-on analysis role in the programme's implementation workstream. You will work across the organisation's KYC, onboarding and periodic review processes. That means establishing how they operate today, defining how they need to operate in future, and turning that into requirements the programme can deliver.

The work is requirements-led. You will engage Financial Crime, Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders, map current and target state processes, and make sure what is configured in Fenergo reflects both internal policy and regulatory obligations. Because the programme is regulatory-driven, the analysis needs to be traceable, well evidenced and able to withstand scrutiny from compliance, audit and risk.

The role suits a business analyst from a financial crime change background, ideally with exposure to a CLM implementation. You should combine structured analysis with the confidence to work directly with subject matter experts and senior stakeholders. This is an initial 6-month engagement, with a strong likelihood of extension to two years as the programme progresses. It is based in London, with three days per week on site, and is expected to start as soon as possible.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Elicit, document and validate business requirements across KYC, CDD, EDD and client onboarding processes.
* Map current and target state processes, identifying gaps against internal policy and regulatory obligations.
* Support the configuration of Fenergo, including policy rules, data requirements, risk models and workflow design.
* Carry out data analysis and data mapping to support the migration of client records onto the new platform.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria, making sure requirements are clear, testable and traceable.
* Support test planning and execution, including UAT, and track defects through to resolution.
* Work with Financial Crime, Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders to secure alignment and sign-off on requirements.
* Contribute to business readiness, including procedure updates, training materials and change impact assessments.

  
**Requirements**  

* A background in business analysis within financial crime, KYC or client onboarding change in financial services.
* A sound understanding of AML, KYC, CDD and EDD requirements, including the UK Money Laundering Regulations and JMLSG guidance.
* Fenergo implementation experience is strongly preferred, though exposure to other CLM platforms will also be considered.
* Strong process mapping, requirements gathering and documentation skills.
* Experience writing user stories and supporting UAT in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
* Confidence working with data, including data mapping and migration analysis.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams.
* A relevant BA certification (e.g. BCS) or financial crime qualification (e.g. ICA) is an advantage.

  
**Benefits**

Length: Initial 6-month contract, with likely extension to two years  
Salary: £42,000–£55,000, dependent on experience

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
LNT/PM/1881906

* PTD-Power Transmission & Distribution - IC
* Jabeli Ali, Dubai

* Posted On 06 Oct 2026
* End Date 04 Apr 2027
* Required Experience16 - 24 years

  

**Skills**
----------

#### **Knowledge & Posting Location**

PMP Program Management Project Management

#### **Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor of Engineering (BE)

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Project Manager is responsible for the overall planning, execution, monitoring, control, and successful delivery of electrical substation projects, including 132kV, 220kV, 400kV, and distribution substations, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, project specifications, quality standards, safety regulations, and client expectations. The role involves leading multidisciplinary teams comprising civil, electrical, mechanical, commissioning, QA/QC, HSE, planning, procurement, and subcontractor personnel to achieve project objectives within approved schedules and budgets. The Project Manager oversees the complete project lifecycle from initiation, engineering coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and final handover, while ensuring effective stakeholder management with clients, consultants, utility authorities, vendors, and subcontractors. Key responsibilities include project planning, resource allocation, schedule monitoring, cost control, risk management, contract administration, progress reporting, and implementation of recovery plans to mitigate delays and project risks. The Project Manager ensures seamless coordination among various disciplines, resolves technical and commercial issues, monitors project performance against key milestones, and drives compliance with quality assurance, quality control, and HSE requirements. The role also includes managing project budgets, evaluating variations and claims, optimizing resource utilization, reviewing project deliverables, overseeing procurement activities, and ensuring timely availability of materials and equipment. Additionally, the Project Manager leads progress review meetings, monitors subcontractor performance, supports testing and commissioning activities, ensures closure of punch points and NCRs, and oversees the preparation of as-built documentation and project closeout reports. The ideal candidate possesses strong leadership, communication, negotiation, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with extensive experience in managing high-voltage substation and EPC projects. Through effective project governance, stakeholder engagement, and strategic leadership, the Project Manager ensures the successful, safe, and profitable delivery of substation projects while meeting client requirements and organizational objectives.

This position is created to support the AGORA ERP implementation within Gas Services Distributed in the United Arab Emirates, with a strategic plan to transition the resource into a permanent Commercial Project Manager (CPM) vacancy to retain critical system and business knowledge. Operating within the SE FIN GS ME CPM-D organization, the role initially will focus on ERP system deployment then will transition to commercial execution in all service lines; long-term service contracts, M&U, Repairs, complex Spare Parts deliveries, Field Services. To address this dual-phase objective, the role focuses on ERP implementation and system optimization, comprehensive financial project management, and risk, contract, and stakeholder management.

These core areas ensure a seamless transition from system setup to high-performing project execution. Given the focus on ERP implementation and project execution, the ideal candidate will have a strong background in finance or business administration, proven experience as a Commercial Project Manager for complex service projects, and deep proficiency in SAP/ERP systems. **How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Collaborate with the Project Manager to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and opportunities. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, subcontractors, and offshore teams, to ensure commercial alignment.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related qualification. Certified CPM for 'C' Category projects
* Proven experience as a Commercial Project Manager handling long-term or complex 'C' category projects, preferably in the service/LTSA sector
* Experience with ERP/SAP implementations in a project business environment
* Strong background in financial reporting guidelines (FRG) and IFRS, project forecasting, budgeting and reporting, asset and cash flow management, as well as transfer pricing and tax compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel and PowerPoint), experience in data stewardship and system implementation, as well as expertise in SAP/ERP implementation.
* Expertise in contract and claim management, project risk and opportunity management, as well as foreign currency hedging and risk mitigation.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, effective stakeholder management and communication abilities, as well as problem-solving skills and adaptability.

**About the Team**

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager Product Development Commercialization
jobs.description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

The Senior Project Manager Commercialization is responsible to lead the project management of all innovation and change management projects for the Commercial Large Store/ Foodservice and On Premise (FSOP) (including Club and E-Commerce) channel, as well as all on-pack marketing promotion projects in the US. Lead cross-functional teams through the company stage gate process with a sound understanding of business/project scope, risk and resource analysis, as well as managing any escalation process with supply chain and commercial leadership. Develop a robust business process with our external network of packaging vendors to drive efficiencies and timely delivery of secondary artwork based with a deep understanding the artwork development process.

**The Impact You'll Make:**
---------------------------

* Take an active role in helping the design/scope of complex projects and project timeline templates or active project plans
* Lead stakeholders with the development of the overall project plan/timeline strategy through stage 0 and 1 leadership
* Lead weekly cross-functional team meetings with supply chain, technical community, and commercial stakeholders for a full report and plan for high complexity projects
* Liaison with packaging vendors for continuous improvement, risk mitigation, and way-of-working development to ensure efficiency in packaging execution
* Track all activities and interact on a daily level to ensure communication or priorities and instill a sense of urgency with all stakeholders in New Product Development (NPD), Operations, Strategic Planning, Quality Assurance, and Commercial.
* Communicate progress and flag delays in timelines to NPD leadership by understanding the critical path of the project at hand to attempt to move the project along.
* Work with internal NPD stakeholders for delivery of tasks such as SAP set up of finished goods, raw materials, and kids as well as packaging development.
* Maintain creative, high performing, and motivated cross-functional teams through challenges, direction setting, coaching, and execution in everyday team interactions.
* Create tools to summarize/facilitate communication of tasks and responsibilities to the overall project team.
* Manage technical integration process with packaging vendors, packaging engineering, and procurement to ensure a timely commercialization of secondary artwork

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* Bachelor's Degree in the field of Science, Engineering, or related field. MBA is a plus
* 5+ years of experience in project management role or supply chain management role involving supply chain development in the consumer goods industry or related business function
* 5+ years of experience in cross-functional team leadership and operations
* Proficient with Microsoft Office suite with an emphasis on analytical and presentation tools (Excel & PowerPoint).
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus

For United States applicants:  
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.  
Read our privacy policy here: Privacy Policy

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for time sensitive decisions, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.

Most Warfighting capabilities assume connectivity, compute, power, or a secure space to work in. On a base or near a data center, these exist. At the edge, they do not. Our warfighters need capabilities that can fight where they do. Anduril Expeditionary Systems is the business line that solves this. We build Menace, a containerized system that arrives by truck, ship, plane, or helicopter, powers on in under ten minutes, and delivers command, compute, or effects with no site prep, no bespoke basing equipment, and no specialized personnel.  
  
The Containerized Effects team focuses on clandestine transport, storage, and launch of containerized effects. You'll work with engineers to build enclosures, launch infrastructure, operating interfaces, and communications that let a small team proliferate munitions and non-kinetic effects with minimal support or reachback. Effect is the outcome, not the mechanism: a missile is an effect, and so is electronic warfare.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Lead the day-to-day coordination and execution of program initiatives and tasks, spanning across Anduril teams and SMEs.
* Provide guidance and direction to program team members, including finance, division operations, mission operations, and other stakeholders to enable program execution.
* Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Systems and Software Engineering teams to mature containerized effect program(s) from prototype to production..

* Deeply understand your customers objectives, constraints, and perspectives.

* Drive and set the standard for the program's communications across the team within Anduril and with key customer and government POCs.
* Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, policies, and procedures associated with the program.
* Identify and mitigate potential risks and issues that may impact program delivery.
* Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency within the program.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated experience as a self-starter, able to find and resolve issues on your own
* Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills
* Strong aptitude for problem solving in unstructured situations at the interface of hardware and software. Ability to drive challenging and vague technical problems to clarity and resolution
* Experience in Program Management. Contract management of/with focused program offices
* Experience with government: business development, contract structures, budget cycles, procurement processes, program funding, and proposal processes
* Comfortable with setting and achieving goals in a complex, fast moving environments with ambiguous requirements
* Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow
* Active U.S. Secret clearance

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience as a program or project manager in defense, tech, consulting or similar field
* Experience managing complex projects in government a plus
* Strong technical background with familiarity in systems engineering, software development, networking, and hardware engineering

**Lead Project Manager**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Regular  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Exempt  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
The **Deep Synoptic Array (DSA)** is a next-generation radio telescope being developed for deployment in a radio-quiet valley in Nevada. Comprising 1,650 dishes, the DSA is designed to survey the sky at unprecedented speed and sensitivity. During its five-year initial survey, the DSA is expected to detect more than one billion astronomical sources, produce images and transient alerts in real time, and rapidly deliver science-ready data products to the astronomical community. The DSA brings together scientists, engineers, technical experts, and project professionals across a large, multidisciplinary collaboration. As the project advances toward construction and operations, the DSA offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and delivery of a major new facility at the forefront of radio astronomy.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The Lead Project Manager, in partnership with the Principal Investigator (PI) team and Deputy Project Manager, provides strategic leadership and integrated project management for the design, development, construction, and future operation of the DSA, one of the world's most advanced radio astronomy initiatives. The position is responsible for coordinating project planning, governance, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, environmental compliance, infrastructure development, and organizational planning across a large, multidisciplinary, multi-institutional collaboration.  
  
Working closely with the Principal Investigators, Deputy Project Manager, Project Engineer, institutional leadership, consultants, contractors, funding agencies, and government organizations, the Lead Project Manager ensures alignment across scientific, engineering, technical, operational, and administrative workstreams while supporting the successful execution of the project from conceptual design through construction and operations.

The Lead Project Manager provides strategic leadership for execution of the DSA project scope, schedule, budget, and integrated project management functions, working in partnership with the Deputy Project Manager and broader project leadership.  

* Serve as the primary project management lead, providing strategic direction across multiple technical, programmatic, and organizational workstreams.

* Direct project management methodologies, governance processes, document control systems, reporting mechanisms, and organizational practices that support effective project execution.

jobs.description:
### **About**

Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. A laureate of the French government’s selective year list of tech champions, “French Tech Next 120,” we are quickly expanding across Europe.

Over 100 European companies have already seamlessly integrated banking services such as accounts, cards, and payments into their products through our Banking-as-a-Service platform. This approach, known as “embedded finance”, empowers businesses to elevate their offerings and create new revenue streams — often times tripling their revenue!

Our founders’ vision from the beginning was Simplicity: that anyone with a fintech idea at 2 am can visit our website, start building, and buy themselves a coffee with a self-issued card the very next day. That vision has taken us far.

Following a 38M€ Series B round last September, we have been doubling our headcount and already have over 230 Swanees across offices in Paris, Bordeaux, Berlin, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Milan! If you’re excited about joining a European fintech adventure, Swan is the way!

**To learn more about us:** **About Swan** **;** **Our story****.**

### **Job description**

Swan is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data team, led by Romain, our VP Data. The team has 9 people across data engineering, analytics engineering and data analysis.

This is a hybrid role. Half of it is being a business partner: you'll work hand in hand with your stakeholders, help them ask the right questions, and turn data into recommendations that shape their decisions.

The other half is making data work better at Swan. As our team has grown, so has the variety in how we build dashboards, define KPIs and document our work. You'll lead the effort to harmonize these practices and bring the team along with you. You'll also run initiatives that help the rest of Swan get more value from data, such as Metabase training and data onboarding for new Swanees.

Think of it as RevOps for data: you'll shape not only what we deliver, but how we work.

**Your mission**

Your mission has two sides:

**Data analysis:**

* **Business partner & project lead:** Work hand in hand with your stakeholders to understand their priorities and help them frame the right questions. Lead data projects end to end, from scoping to delivery, and turn analyses into recommendations that shape their decisions.
* **Owner of your domain's data logic:** Make sure the data in your scope reflects how the business really works. Define and maintain KPIs, investigate edge cases, write clear specifications for the modeling logic, and safeguard data quality. When needed, you'll build the dbt models yourself.
* **Data product manager for your dashboards:** Build and maintain the Metabase dashboards and EXCO reports for your domain. Treat them as products: understand how they're used, keep them reliable and relevant, and retire what's no longer needed.

**Data Enablement & Operations:**

* **Turn ideas into delivered projects:** Take improvement ideas from across the team, including leadership's, and turn them into structured projects with a clear scope, plan and owners. Then carry them through to the end, long after the kick-off energy has faded.
* **Harmonize how the data team works:** Lead internal initiatives that make the team more efficient and consistent, such as a shared dashboard lifecycle, a common process for defining and validating KPIs, the data catalog and its upkeep, and clear documentation of our practices.
* **Drive adoption and lead change within the team:** Consult analysts before designing new standards, build buy-in by involving them early and starting with quick wins, and support the team through the change until the new ways of working become the norm.
* **Drive AI adoption within the team:** Identify where AI can make analysts more effective, from writing SQL to documenting dashboards and answering recurring requests. Test new tools and practices, and help the team adopt the ones that deliver real value.
* **Help the rest of Swan get value from data**: Run internal projects for stakeholders, such as Metabase training and a data onboarding program for new Swanees, so that teams become more autonomous and confident with data.

### **Preferred experience**

**You’re a great match if:**

* You have **6+ years of experience in data analytics** and have worked closely with business stakeholders, ideally non-technical ones.
* You're **fluent in SQL** and at ease with a BI tool such as Metabase.
* You've **led the adoption of new standards or processes across a team**, convincing peers without having authority over them, and can show what changed as a result.
* You're **pragmatic about process**: you know how to keep standards lightweight and focused on what really solves the problem.
* You have **grit and follow-through**: you're the person who turns ideas into reality, keeps momentum when things get slow or messy, and doesn't let a project quietly die.
* You enjoy **sharing knowledge**: training, documentation, onboarding or helping others become autonomous with data.
* You handle **sensitive or confidential data** with care and discretion.
* You're excited by a **hybrid role**, half business partner, half making the team and the company work better with data.
* You share our values: **team spirit, transparency, ownership**, and the humility to keep learning.

**Even better if:**

* You have experience with **dbt** or building data marts.
* You've worked on **data catalogs, KPI governance or dashboard lifecycle** initiatives.

It’s okay if you don’t tick all the boxes — don’t let imposter syndrome prevent you from applying!
