jobs.title: Senior Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
***Before we get started:***  
Here at Ingenio, we'd love to talk with you regardless of your qualifications or years of experience. If you believe you'd be a great fit for this role, we invite you to apply even if you do not meet all points on the job description.

***Who we are:***  
Ingenio is on a mission to make spiritual wellness a core part of modern self-care. We are a global media and technology company developing products that provide guidance on love, relationships, careers, and all aspects of life. We are passionate about connecting people with the world's best advisors and content to restore spiritual wellness to its rightful place, easing the stress of modern life with trusted ancient practices.

Our global portfolio spans over 20 marketplace and media brands in the spiritual and emotional wellness space. Our flagship brands include Keen, Horoscope.com, Astrology.com, Purple Garden, Kasamba, and Kang.

***How you'll be impactful:***  
We are seeking a Senior Business Data Analyst to elevate our understanding of financial, product, and marketing performance across our EU brand portfolio. The ideal candidate will have expertise in B2C financial monitoring, marketplace dynamics, product analytics, and marketing analytics, along with experience analyzing interactions between buyers and sellers. This role involves communicating insights to executive leadership and partnering with Marketplace Success, Product, and Marketing teams by developing and managing Tableau reports that track key metrics, playing a critical part in shaping strategic direction and optimizing brand performance. Our European data currently sits across multiple local and international systems, so a key part of this role is connecting and reconciling these sources into a consistent, trusted view of performance.  
  
*Please note: This role will require being in our Paris office at least 3 days per week.*

  

***What*** ***you'll be doing:***

* Lead financial analysis of brand results: Revenue, Engagement, Retention; and create analysis to better understand both supply and demand behavior.
* Connect and reconcile data across local and international systems to build a consistent, trusted view of European performance.
* Partner with executive leadership to surface insights and drive accountability and growth.
* Partner with Marketplace Success to increase retention and monetization of loyal customers; utilization and revenue of sellers.
* Analyze product usage and user behavior to inform feature development, funnel optimization, and onboarding improvements, partnering closely with Product teams.
* Evaluate marketing campaign performance across channels, including acquisition efficiency, attribution, and ROAS, partnering closely with Marketing teams.
* Proactively explore available data to generate actionable insights and advocate strategies that increase business value.
* Maintain reports, decks and dashboards that track KPIs and provide insights into marketplace, product, and marketing effectiveness and ROI.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify key issues and opportunities, support business strategy based on data-driven insights.

***What*** ***you'll need to be successful:***

* 5+ years of experience analyzing marketplace operations, revenue analytics, product analytics, marketing analytics, consulting, finance, or business strategy.
* Bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, economics or related quantitative fields.
* Exceptional skills in Google Sheets, Excel, Slides, Powerpoint, data extraction and analysis.
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Skilled in Tableau/Data visualization software. Familiarity with Python and/or R is a plus.
* Experience working with fragmented or legacy data environments (multiple local/international systems) is a strong plus.
* Experience in analysis of revenue, customer behavior and marketplace dynamics. Familiarity with Product Analytics tools (Mixpanel) and marketing analytics/attribution platforms is a plus.
* Proven ability to frame and solve problems by extracting insight from raw data.
* Team player with a result-oriented approach, capable of navigating ambiguity and initiating/driving projects to completion.
* Expert in creation of presentations and reports for executive leadership to communicate findings, recommendations, and performance metrics. Exceptional communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Fluent French and English required; German is a plus given the European scope of this role.

***Perks & Benefits:***

* Collaborative, high-performing, and entrepreneurial team
* Employee referral bonus program
* Company swag
* Birthday PTO
* Summer Fridays
* Meal vouchers
* Learning & development support, including dedicated budget
* Regular in-person and virtual team events

***Why Ingenio?***  
Our growing team of over 300 employees is powered by our diverse perspectives and company core values:

* We are humble. We believe the best result is achieved by leveraging others' perspectives
* We think like owners. We make decisions that optimize for the greater good of the organization
* We challenge limiting beliefs. We are at our best when we identify and shatter status quo expectations

*Ingenio is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.*

jobs.title: Stagiaire Data Analyst – Commercial Data Performance F/H
jobs.description:
Context:

As the world’s leading private airport operator, VINCI Airports manages over 70 airports across 14 countries in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. Leveraging its expertise as a global integrator, VINCI Airports develops, finances, builds, and operates airports, bringing its investment capacity and know-how in optimizing operational performance, modernizing infrastructure, and driving their environmental transition.

For more information: www.vinci-airports.com

  

Job Description:

  

We are looking for a Data Analyst – Commercial Data Performance to join our team for an internship of 6 to 12 months. You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and governance of commercial data across our airport network, while turning that data into actionable insights. You will work alongside the Data team at VINCI Airports headquarters, the Commercial Performance Manager, and commercial teams at our airports.

  

What will you find when you arrive:

* A dynamic environment that fosters excellence

* A Data Division that works hand in hand with Data sponsors, business experts (aeronautical and non-aeronautical marketing, airport operations, etc.) and airport subsidiaries

* Demanding yet supportive management that will guide your professional development

* An internship within a dynamic company with employment opportunities in France and internationally

  

Missions:

Reporting to the Commercial Performance Manager at VINCI Airports, your missions will include:

* Analyze commercial performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement

* Contribute to data governance practices: help define business rules, maintain data documentation, and support the data catalog for commercial data

* Implement and monitor data quality KPIs to ensure commercial data is accurate, consistent, and reliable

* Profile and investigate data quality issues, working with business teams to resolve them at the source

* Build and maintain dashboards to track commercial KPIs and data quality across airports

* Conduct ad-hoc analyses to support strategic decision-making

Desired Skills:

* Good command of SQL for data querying and analysis

* Familiarity with data visualization tools (Power BI, Looker Studio, or equivalent)

* Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, dynamic charts)

* Interest in or exposure to a programming language (Python preferred) is a plus

* Awareness of Data Governance and Data Quality concepts is a plus

* Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and good communication skills

  

Work Environment:

You will work in a cross-functional environment, interacting with a variety of teams:

* Data team

* Airport operational teams (operations, commercial and aero)

* Data sponsors of the Business Units

This position will give you hands-on experience with data governance and quality in a commercial context, and a comprehensive view of how reliable data drives performance across a global airport network.

  

Profile:

* You are a student from an Engineering School, Business School, or pursuing a master's in Data, Business Analytics, or a related field.

  

Languages:

* Fluency in English, required for the role.

* French

En tant qu'opérateur global, VINCI Airports conçoit, construit et opère plus de 70 aéroports à travers le monde. En intégrant l'ensemble des enjeux locaux, actuels ou futurs, VINCI Airports libère le potentiel de chacune des infrastructures aéroportuaires qui lui sont confiées tout en minimisant leur impact sur l'environnement.

jobs.title: Chemical & Natural Resources Cybersecurity Manager/Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**We Are**

Accenture's Cybersecurity practice, a global leader in delivering end-to-end cybersecurity services across strategy, risk management, digital identity, cyber defense, and managed security. With security professionals in 70 countries and specialized facilities like Cyber Fusion Centers and Cyber Labs, we focus on embedding security into digital transformation programs, and delivering targeted cybersecurity solutions to protect digital assets, manage cybersecurity risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. We address the evolving challenges of cybersecurity in today's digital landscape. Our cybersecurity practice is supported by a global network of cybersecurity professionals, advanced tools, and partnerships with leading technology providers. We help organizations build resilience, protect their operations, and enable growth in a secure digital environment.

**You Are**

Passionate about leveraging cybersecurity innovation to drive strategic transformation across the Chemicals & Natural Resources (CNR) industries, including chemical manufacturers, oil & gas operators, mining companies, and agricultural enterprises. You develop and deliver cybersecurity services that protect critical infrastructure, enable operational modernization, manage enterprise and operational risk, and support compliance with industry-specific regulatory requirements. This role demands deep expertise across IT and OT environments and the ability to guide CNR clients through complex business, technology, safety, and resilience challenges. You assess current and future cybersecurity capabilities, advise on leading practices, and shape cybersecurity strategies aligned with each client's business priorities, regulatory obligations, and operational realities.

**The Work:**

As a Cybersecurity Manager, you will manage complex information security engagements and workstreams. You will provide cybersecurity subject matter expertise, coordinate project delivery, and serve as a key point of contact for client security, business, and IT stakeholders, Accenture domain experts, and third-party teams. You will lead; manage plans, risks, budgets, and deliverables; and help shape practical solutions that achieve committed client outcomes.

As a team member, you'll be part of a Chemicals & Natural Resources industry team focused on applying cybersecurity expertise across the CNR value chain — from upstream exploration and extraction, to refining, processing, and distribution, through to chemical manufacturing and end-product delivery. You'll work closely with our CNR industry leaders to innovate and shape secure, resilient solutions for operational technology modernization, supply chain security, and industrial process safety.

* **Client Engagement:** Build trusted working relationships with chemical, oil & gas, mining, and agricultural client stakeholders, translating their cybersecurity, safety, regulatory, and operational resilience priorities into actionable workplans and deliverables.
* **Initiative Delivery:** Manage cybersecurity workstreams and project teams delivering solutions across cyber defense, AI-enabled security, risk management, and compliance, aligned with client objectives, scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
* **CNR Insight & Strategy Development:** Apply deep knowledge of CNR operations, regulatory obligations, threat trends, and technology modernization to shape practical client strategies tailored to chemical, energy, and natural resource environments.
* **Innovative Strategy Formulation:** Collaborate with CNR clients to create and implement forward-looking strategies that secure operational technology modernization, process control systems, supply chain digitization, cloud adoption, and IT/OT convergence while protecting worker safety, environmental compliance, and operational continuity.
* **Secure AI:** Support CNR clients in the secure adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning across industrial operations — including AI-driven process optimization, predictive maintenance, and autonomous systems — ensuring AI deployments are implemented with security, safety, and governance controls embedded from inception.
* **Team Leadership & Development:** Supervise and coach project team members, assign work, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing delivery environment.
* **Communication & Reporting:** Develop clear recommendations, status reports, and executive-ready materials; present findings and delivery progress to client and Accenture stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to align security initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cybersecurity assessments, strategy workstreams, and implementation activities across CNR enterprise and operational environments, including IT, OT/ICS, cloud, process control networks, distributed control systems (DCS), SCADA, historian systems, and manufacturing execution systems (MES), while supporting applicable requirements such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-82, EPA Risk Management Program, TSA Security Directives, CIRCIA, API 1164, and industry-specific HSE regulations.
* Support senior leaders in advising CNR stakeholders on integrating cybersecurity risk management into operational resilience, capital programs, plant modernization, emergency preparedness, and sustainability initiatives.
* Manage CNR cybersecurity transformation workstreams focused on secure IT/OT convergence, network segmentation, internal network security monitoring, threat detection modernization, cyber resilience, and identity and access management for critical industrial infrastructure.
* Facilitate CNR-specific threat modeling, incident response, and recovery-readiness activities for risks such as ransomware, nation-state activity, supply chain compromise, insecure remote access, and attacks affecting chemical plants, ref

jobs.description:

**SavvyMoney** is a leading San Francisco East Bay fintech company. We provide integrated credit score and personal finance solutions to 1,600 + bank and credit union partners nationally. The SavvyMoney solutions integrate with more than 43 digital banking platforms.

**SavvyMoney was recently recognized by the San Francisco Business Times and the Silicon Valley Journal as one of the "Top 25 Places to Work in the San Francisco Bay Area" and is an Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Company.**

We pride ourselves on a culture of collaboration, innovation, and mutual respect, a team that supports each other’s growth, celebrates successes, and genuinely enjoys the work we do.  
  
**\*\*Our corporate offices are located in Dublin, CA. We offer a flexible/hybrid work environment with some days at the corporate offices and some days working from home.**

As SavvyMoney’s product portfolio continues to grow, successful launches require more than strong products. They require clear processes, cross-functional alignment, operational readiness, and consistent execution.

We are seeking a highly organized and collaborative **Program Manager, Product Marketing** to serve as the operational backbone connecting Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Partner Success. Reporting to the Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will lead the programs and processes that move new products and enhancements from the roadmap through pilot, launch, and general availability.

This role will be responsible for creating structure across complex, cross-functional initiatives, improving how teams work together, and continuously strengthening our launch and go-to-market processes. Success means helping SavvyMoney bring products to market efficiently, ensuring internal teams and partners are prepared, and creating repeatable processes that support our continued growth.

--------------------

**Program & Launch Management:** Lead cross-functional coordination for product launches and enhancements from planning through general availability. Develop and manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables, facilitate readiness meetings, proactively identify and escalate risks, and drive accountability to keep launches on track.

**Pilot Program Management:** Plan, coordinate, and oversee pilot programs for new products and enhancements. Partner with Product Owners and Partner Management to identify pilot participants, establish objectives and success criteria, manage communications and timelines, collect feedback, track results, and provide recommendations to support broader product releases.

**Cross-Functional Readiness:** Drive organizational readiness across Product Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, Operations, and other stakeholder groups. **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear and consistent communication throughout the product development and launch process. Deliver regular project updates, document key decisions, track action items, surface risks and dependencies, and ensure stakeholders and leadership have the information needed to make timely decisions.

**Performance Measurement & Reporting:** Define and monitor measures of program and launch success, including launch readiness, milestone completion, pilot outcomes, time-to-market, internal readiness, partner adoption, and other relevant operational metrics. Develop reports and dashboards that provide Product Marketing leadership with visibility into program health, launch performance, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Build trusted relationships across Product Management, Product Marketing, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Partner Success. jobs.title: Deal Strategy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are seeking a **Deal Strategy Program Manager** to help us scale how we support our sales organization. This role is a critical partner to sales and collaborates closely with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations, helping move deals forward with speed, sound judgment, and operational rigor. Beyond executing day-to-day deal support, this role independently owns complex deals end-to-end, shapes the processes and systems the broader team relies on, and is a go-to resource for less-experienced teammates.

You'll play a central role in structuring deals, improving process quality, and helping our sales team close business efficiently and responsibly. We're looking for someone who operates with real autonomy, exercises sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and is energized by solving problems in a fast-paced environment. This is a strong next step for someone who has built foundational deal desk or revenue operations experience and is ready to own outcomes independently, influence process and policy, and begin mentoring others.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own Deal Execution**

* Serve as a senior, trusted advisor to Sales leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on structuring and executing complex, non-standard, and high-value deals
* Independently evaluate and resolve non-standard deal requests, driving cross-functional solutions across Sales, Finance, and Legal with minimal oversight
* Own deals end-to-end through quoting, approval, contracting, and quote-to-cash — troubleshooting issues with Finance and Legal with urgency, accuracy, and attention to policy and business context
* Ensure all transactions adhere to internal revenue recognition policies, escalating and resolving edge cases as needed
* Present deal strategy recommendations and insights to senior stakeholders in a clear, concise, data-driven manner

**Elevate Operational Quality**

* Ensure deal data is complete and accurate in CRM, with a focus on data hygiene and process compliance
* Reinforce and help enforce pricing and discounting governance, exercising judgment in gray areas rather than simply applying rules
* Define requirements for system enhancements (e.g., CRM, CPQ) in partnership with systems and RevOps teams

**Drive Process Improvement & Scale**

jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

Muon seeks a Spacecraft Harnessing Technical Program Manager to lead the end-to-end planning, procurement, manufacturing, acceptance testing, and delivery of prototype, test, and flight cable assemblies and interconnect systems for our next-generation satellite constellations. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical integration, high-reliability manufacturing, and Assembly, Integration, and Test (AI&T).

The Harnessing TPM will serve as the primary operational owner for transforming harness schematics and mechanical routing designs into fully tested, flight-ready interconnect networks. The role spans detailed hardware release planning, supply chain coordination, testing execution, and fleet-scale delivery across multiple concurrent spacecraft builds and test environments.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Please note: This role will need full time on-site (5x/week) for the first six months for a ramp up period and then can transition to hybrid schedule (3x/week).

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Hardware Delivery**
  + Spacecraft Harness Delivery: Own the end-to-end planning and execution of all spacecraft harnessing needs entering AI&T, delivering complete, fully tested, and flight-ready interconnect assemblies for vehicle integration.
  + Testbed Fleet Support: Deliver complete, validated harnessing systems to Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) testbeds to support ongoing Flight Software (FSW) development, verification, and mission simulations for each satellite mission.
  + Future Mission Planning: Support engineering teams by planning harness architecture development for future constellation blocks and driving cross-functional execution across design, procurement, fabrication, and testing.
* **Program Execution & Reporting**
  + Cross-Functional Execution: Drive end-to-end program alignment across electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, supply chain, and vehicle AI&T teams to meet critical assembly and integration milestones.
  + Program Metrics & Reporting: Track, analyze, and report key harnessing program metrics—including schedule status, resource allocation, risk posture, technical performance, and cost variance.
* **Supply Chain & Risk Management**
  + Procurement & Production Tracking: Track the procurement, fabrication, and assembly status for all custom wire harnesses, specialized connectors, contacts, backshells, and associated mechanical shielding.
  + Issue Resolution: Proactively identify, track, and drive resolution for supply chain bottlenecks, component lead time spikes, design changes, and manufacturing or testing fallouts.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering leadership, or hardware production management delivering complex electromechanical assemblies, cable harnesses, or aerospace hardware.
* Hands-on technical background in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or wire harness manufacturing and testing.
* Proven track record managing harness production lifecycles—from initial routing schematics and pinout definition through procurement, wire assembly, continuity/hipot testing, and acceptance.
* Demonstrated experience managing programs with a complex, multi-tiered, critical-path supply chain.
* Familiarity with program management scheduling and tracking tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
* U.S. Citizenship required (program is ITAR-restricted).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Direct experience in satellite or aerospace AI&T, vehicle interconnect manufacturing, or satellite constellation volume production.
* Working knowledge of space-grade wiring and crimping standards (e.g., NASA-STD-8739.4, IPC/WHMA-A-620 Space Addendum).
* Familiarity with hardware/software integration environments, testbeds, or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) simulators used for flight software development.
* Experience managing environmental and electrical acceptance testing campaigns for cabling (e.g., high-potential testing, continuity verification, outgassing considerations, mass properties).
* Proficiency with ERP/PLM and tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Arena, Agile PLM, SAP, or similar toolsets).
* PMP certification or equivalent program management credentials.
* Experience with harness and/or mechanical CAD software (such as RapidHarness, Solidworks, etc).

**Salary**
----------

The salary range for this role is $174,000 - $199,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

**About Muon Space**
--------------------

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

This role directly supervises a team of experienced professionals across the Business Systems Team and ProgramData Management Team, setting multi-year objectives, establishing program roadmaps, and leading complex initiatives from planning through implementation and transition to sustained operations.

**We're here for the same mission, to bring science solutions to the world. Join our team and YOU will play a supporting role in our goal to address global challenges! Have a high level of impact and work for an organization associated with 17 Nobel Prizes!**

We invest in our employees by offering a total rewards package you can count on:

* Exceptional health and retirement benefits, including pension or 401K-style plans
* Opportunities to grow in your career - check out our Tuition Assistance Program

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Program Manager and Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Digital Test & Evaluation (T&E)** tohelp modernize traditional defense T&E processes through digital engineering, modeling and simulation, software integration, data orchestration, DevSecOps, and cloud and edge technologies. This role will support the development and implementation of an enterprise Digital T&E ecosystem that connects users, tools, data, models, simulations, and test resources to enable faster, more continuous, data-driven testing and decision-making. Working across test organizations, program offices, ranges, laboratories, cybersecurity teams, operational users, and commercial vendors, the Technical Program Manager will translate mission and technical requirements into executable pilots, software requirements, integration plans, and transition strategies to support the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU).

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage Digital T&E prototype efforts from problem definition and market research through technical diligence, pilot execution, user evaluation, and transition.

* Design and evaluate end-to-end T&E workflows that connect requirements, mission and systems engineering, modeling and simulation, test planning, test execution, test data collection, analysis, reporting, and decision support.
* Apply working knowledge of test strategy and design to help teams define Measures of Performance (MoPs), Measures of Effectiveness (MoEs), test objectives, data requirements, evidence thresholds, and the appropriate mix of modeling and simulation, laboratory, cyber, and physical-range testing.

* Identify and resolve technical barriers associated with APIs, data schemas, metadata, containerization, software deployment, network connectivity, data federation, tool interoperability, and integration with existing systems of record.
* Work with Government test organizations, program offices, users, data owners, security teams, software vendors, and infrastructure providers to establish realistic pilot architectures and execution plans.
* Conduct technical due diligence of commercial software and emerging T&E technologies, assessing product maturity, architectural fit, interoperability, security posture, data rights, scalability, user experience, and potential to improve T&E outcomes.
* Create and lead collaborative teams of Government and commercial entities to prototype, integrate, test, and evaluate commercial Digital T&E solutions in operationally relevant environments.

* Demonstrated familiarity with one or more Digital T&E / digital engineering disciplines such as MBSE, mission engineering, modeling and simulation, digital twins, test management, DevSecOps/CI/CD, automated test, data orchestration, data analytics/visualization, AI/ML, or digital-thread architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and manage software integration in defense environments, including APIs and data exchange, cloud and edge deployment, containerized applications, government networks, cybersecurity/RMF and ATO processes, identity/access controls, CUI and classified-data handling, and interoperability with legacy systems.
* Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to translate operational and test-user problems into technically actionable software requirements and pilot architectures.

jobs.description:
**Site Security Manager**

**About the role:** The Site Security Manager (SSM) serves as the day-to-day manager of a 24/7 datacenter physical security operations team, supporting a client’s datacenter or other critical facility. Reporting to a Campus Security Manager (CSM), the SSM builds a cohesive, high-performing team that delivers a safe, secure, and compliant environment while meeting client expectations. The SSM also collaborates with other campus security leaders to maintain consistent security standards across the campus. Additional responsibilities may include client service and issue resolution, service enhancements, Security Operations Center (SOC) systems maintenance, audit compliance, system monitoring, log and documentation maintenance, and access rights administration. Based on coverage needs, the SSM may be required to support and provide leadership coverage at other assigned sites within the campus/region in addition to their primary site.

**What you’ll do:** In this role, the Site Security Manager (SSM) leads the on‑site security team and oversees day‑to‑day security operations within a 24/7 environment. You are responsible for directly managing security personnel, including administrative officers, responders, control room staff, and other security team members, while ensuring consistent staffing coverage and operational continuity.

You partner with local leadership to support recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, and employee development. This includes coaching and mentoring team members, setting expectations, and managing performance and corrective actions in line with company policy. You also work closely with client leadership across multiple business groups to support site operations.

Operationally, you ensure compliance with security policies, procedures, and standard operating guidelines. You monitor site performance and key metrics, identify risks or security gaps, and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement. You maintain required documentation, logs, and reports, oversee on‑site security systems such as access control, CCTV, and incident management tools, and support audits, inspections, and other compliance activities.

The role requires clear, professional communication with clients and internal partners, including leading meetings and presentations. You escalate significant events and risks as needed, promote safe work practices, handle sensitive information with discretion, and support additional operational needs as they arise.

**What you need to apply:** To apply for this role, you should have an associate degree and 6+ years of relevant experience in the security industry, including 3+ years of managing people. Experience leading teams in a security and/or datacenter environment is strongly preferred. You should also have hands‑on experience with security technologies such as CCTV, access control systems, incident management tools, and video surveillance platforms. Strong, practical proficiency with Microsoft Office is expected, as reporting, documentation, and operational tracking are essential parts of the role.

This position is best suited for a proven people leader who is comfortable balancing operational leadership, administrative accountability, and client‑facing responsibilities within a 24/7 security environment.

All applicants must have reliable means of communication and transportation (public or private) to travel to and from work, the legal right to work in the country where the position is located, and proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing in English and a common local language (where applicable).

Applicants must also be able and willing to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays (such as during emergencies or high‑priority events). Applicants must be able to meet and continue to meet licensing requirements for security officers, as applicable to local, county, and state laws and regulations.

**What you’ll get:** We offer more than just a job; we offer the chance to be part of a collaborative and supportive team where your contributions are valued and your growth matters. In this role, you will thrive in a dynamic environment while supporting a prestigious multinational client account. You will gain exposure to global operations and cross-regional collaboration, and you will have access to continuous learning, training programs, and career development opportunities designed to help you succeed.

**The extra stuff:** Candidates must be at least 18 years old, legally authorized to work in the job location, and willing to complete the company’s pre‑employment screening, including a background check and drug screening. This role may require evening, overnight, or weekend work, particularly during emergencies or high‑priority events. Work may occur in outdoor or inclement weather or environments requiring protective gear and heightened safety awareness. The role requires the physical ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods (up to 12 miles/19 km per shift), climb stairs, and occasionally lift up to 25 pounds (11 kg).

Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location.

  

**About Us**
============

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

**Role Summary**
================

RVT vehicles for Volkswagen Group programs combine RVT zonal and platform ECUs with secondary ECUs (2nd ECUs) supplied by the VWG brands. Every RVT domain team has to integrate against those 2nd ECUs, and all of it depends on a shared network interface definition. Today that definition is largely handed to us by VWG and our domains are mainly taking in what they receive. We need to move to a world where each RVT domain owns its interfaces and changes flow incrementally rather than in large releases.

You will join the SW Systems Architecture team and partner with the interface architecture leads to run the network interface program inside RVT, drive the transition from consuming VWG's definition to domain owned interfaces, roll out the frameworks the architects define for 2nd ECUs, and give domain teams and leadership one current view of where each 2nd ECU stands. The architects set the technical direction. You turn it into a plan, a cadence and a set of artifacts the organization can execute against.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Own the program plan for taking the RVT network interface to a fully defined and versioned baseline for each VWG program (Package 1, Package 2.1, Package 2.2 and beyond).
* Map out and drive the transition plan, per domain and per program, for moving interface ownership from VWG into the RVT domains, including what has to be true at each step and where the interim dependencies on VWG remain.
* Document and roll out the workflow the architects define for network interface versioning and change management inside RVT, including how incoming VWG interface changes are reviewed, how deltas reach the domains and how changes get closed out.
* Run the domain review cadence for interface changes and chase open items to closure across the domain teams.
* Coordinate network definition change requests from VWG, making sure impact is assessed by the right RVT owners and the outcome gets back to VWG.
* Roll out the framework the architects define for what has to be captured per 2nd ECU (functional spec, network interface needs, SW and HW version plan, OTA compliance, integration prerequisites), drive the domains to fill it in, and roll up the results.
* Maintain the up to date view of 2nd ECU maturity and risk per program that can be escalated to RVT and VWG leadership, and make the gaps visible when information from the brands does not exist.
* Operate the handoff between architecture level definition and the active integration tracking owned by the domain and program TPM teams.
* Set up the forums, status rhythm and documentation for this area, and act as the point of contact for VWG TPM counterparts on networking and 2nd ECU planning.

**Qualifications**
==================

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* 8+ years of technical program management on products that integrate hardware, software and mechanical systems, including embedded or vehicle programs taken from concept to production.
* Strong organization and the ability to influence and move an organization without direct authority, across every domain team and two parent companies.
* Experience planning and driving multi-step transitions of ownership or process across teams while the program keeps moving.
* Comfort in ambiguity. You can take a framework from the technical leads, turn it into a working process and artifacts, and iterate as the program evolves.
* Enough hands-on software or hardware background to follow architecture discussions and ask the right questions of architects and domain engineers.
* Experience bridging Agile and waterfall processes across partner organizations. Advanced Jira and Confluence.

-----------------

This is a strategy-to-execution role focused on post-acquisition integration: bringing acquired companies' legal teams, legal entities, contracts, litigation and matters, outside counsel relationships, and compliance obligations into the Lyft Legal organization. To be clear, this is a business and organizational M&A integration role, not a systems or technology integration role. You will serve as the operating backbone for Legal across our most strategic transactions, owning the legal workstream of M&A integration in partnership with Lyft's Corporate Development Integration Management Office (IMO), along with the intake and governance layer that connects the Legal team to deal work. **About Mission Underwriting Services**

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best—underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

**What We Offer:**

* Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* 401K, 401K Match
* Life and Disability Benefits
* Unaccrued Paid Time Off
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Employee Discounts
* Employee Assistance Program

* Employee Referral Program

**What You'll Do**

* Analyze business requirements and determine the appropriate tools and approaches, and the application of standards and best practices. Collaborate with other team members to adhere to our standards, framework, and best practices for delivery of technology applications and products.

* Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders to identify emerging trends, needs and opportunities to provide distinctive value and outcomes from the services and data.
* Maintain a strategic outlook and stay current with leading technology products and techniques.
* Develop and maintain a working knowledge of key business processes to be seen as a trusted advisor to the business in bringing technology to bear on business problems and procedures.
* Conduct testing of software deployment and updates.
* Assist in managing projects, including developing project plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Participate in testing and quality assurance of systems and processes.
* Provide support and training to end-users on new systems and processes.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field; OR 5+ years of progressive experience in financial services, insurance, or data analytics industry.
* Proven success in business requirements gathering, design and development proper documentation for prioritization within the overall roadmap and technology direction.
* Knowledge of business key performance indicators (KPIs) with a preference in KPIs for the risk, insurance, and claims industry.
* Demonstrated ability in business facilitation and effective use of project management techniques/tools.
* Client facing experience is required
* Ability to travel up to 15% of the year

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years Insurance Company, MGA or TPA experience preferred.
* 5+ years of Business Analyst experience preferred.
* Experience in the commercial insurance industry and regulatory environment.
* Project management experience and managing business projects for the full life cycle, from inception to implementation.
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

* Working knowledge of insurance technology (i.e., policy and program admin systems)

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Self-motivated and innovative with the ability to set direction, organize and manage own work, and effectively work in collaboration with others.
* Ability to synthesize requests, uncover inherent trends, make recommendations about associated implications to business performance, communicate findings and recommendations to a variety of audiences and overall technology roadmap.
* Ability to acquire core business acumen within a given industry or customer segment
* Relationship building
* Conflict resolution
* Team player
* Project management
* Financial analysis
* Commercial acumen
* Communication and presentation acumen

**This is a remote position. Planned, in-office activities may be required on occasion (typically 2-4x per year).**

Accenture's Cybersecurity practice, a global leader in delivering end-to-end cybersecurity services across strategy, risk management, digital identity, cyber defense, and managed security. With security professionals in 70 countries and specialized facilities like Cyber Fusion Centers and Cyber Labs, we focus on embedding security into digital transformation programs, and delivering targeted cybersecurity solutions to protect digital assets, manage cybersecurity risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. We address the evolving challenges of cybersecurity in today's digital landscape. Our cybersecurity practice is supported by a global network of cybersecurity professionals, advanced tools, and partnerships with leading technology providers. We help organizations build resilience, protect their operations, and enable growth in a secure digital environment.

Passionate about leveraging cybersecurity innovation to drive strategic transformation across the Chemicals & Natural Resources (CNR) industries, including chemical manufacturers, oil & gas operators, mining companies, and agricultural enterprises. This role demands deep expertise across IT and OT environments and the ability to guide CNR clients through complex business, technology, safety, and resilience challenges. * **Team Leadership & Development:** Supervise and coach project team members, assign work, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing delivery environment.
* **Communication & Reporting:** Develop clear recommendations, status reports, and executive-ready materials; present findings and delivery progress to client and Accenture stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to align security initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cybersecurity assessments, strategy workstreams, and implementation activities across CNR enterprise and operational environments, including IT, OT/ICS, cloud, process control networks, distributed control systems (DCS), SCADA, historian systems, and manufacturing execution systems (MES), while supporting applicable requirements such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-82, EPA Risk Management Program, TSA Security Directives, CIRCIA, API 1164, and industry-specific HSE regulations.

* 5+ years of experience working in an Agile delivery environment, with a good understanding of Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog management, dependencies, and delivery tracking.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Manufacturing PMO
new_jobs.description:
At Crestron Electronics, Inc we build the technology that integrates technology.
  
  
We are proud to be the largest and most recognized brand in automation and control solutions, and the premier technology partner for fortune 500 businesses globally. Our products’ are integrated into new high-tech commercial buildings’ to include some of the most exciting real estate throughout the world. Our clients include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, LinkedIn and many others. We are the leaders in the most exciting industry in the world!
  
Our automation and control solutions for homes and buildings allow our clients to control entire environments with the push of a button, integrating systems such as Audio Visual, Lighting, Shading, Security, Building Management Systems and HVAC to provide greater comfort, convenience and security.
  
  
The Sr. Project Manager – Manufacturing PMO is responsible for leading the transition of new products from Engineering into Production, serving as the primary manufacturing and supply chain project management interface between Engineering and Operations. This role owns planning and execution of multiple New Product Introduction (NPI) projects, ensuring manufacturing readiness, supplier alignment, and successful product launches.
  
  
Partnering closely with Design Engineering Project Managers, the Manufacturing PM develops integrated project plans that incorporate manufacturing strategy, supplier readiness, cost targets, and production risk mitigation early in the development lifecycle. The role works cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Contract Manufacturers, and internal manufacturing teams to coordinate builds, validate readiness, and execute production ramps and transfers.
  
  
Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this position drives execution across internal and external organizations, proactively identifying risks, resolving schedule and resource conflicts, and holding teams accountable to deliverables. The Project Manager brings strong project management discipline, clear communication, and the ability to translate technical and supply chain complexity into actionable plans and concise stakeholder updates.
  
The position requires knowledge of project management methodologies, manufacturing NPI processes, and supply/demand requirements. It requires the ability to translate technical and supply chain complexity into clear, actionable plans and executive-level communication. The Project Manager plays a critical role in manufacturing execution supporting NPI delivery.
  
Strong knowledge of Project Management Processes, PMBOK, and project planning are essential. Strong computer skills in MS Project and MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio) are required.
  
\*\*\* This role is Hybrid and candidates must be local to our New Jersey office.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Monitor and control projects (identify/monitor risks, hold project status meetings with cross functional teams to monitor deliverables, resolve conflicts, manage priorities, resources, and issues, manage scope/changes, update project plans as necessary)
* Create project plans for manufacturing process and support of NPI products (plan deliverables, create schedule baseline, manage dependencies)
* Manage prototype builds in production, host product reviews with Engineering and Operations, assign and manage action items
* Create procurement plans, manage custom designed part FAI approvals, identify and manage long lead parts to be ready for prototype and production builds.
* Coordinate launch plans for internal direct launches at Orangeburg factory, direct launches or transfer of products to contract manufacturers, host Launch Readiness Reviews with all stakeholders.
* Review product roadmaps with Engineering PMO and Product Management, identify product discontinuations, replacement products, work with supply chain to plan demand changes.

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering
* 5 - 8 years experience in Project Management, ability to lead multiple large scale projects simultaneously
* Strong Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Power BI skills
* Strong Project Management process skills
* Strong data analysis, problem solving and decision-making skills
* Teamwork, communication and interpersonal skills
* Enterprise resource planning skills (SAP a plus)

Per applicable state requirements, the annual pay range for this position ($91,500 - $131,000) which consists of base salary (subject to performance), reflects the hiring range for candidates. Also note, an individual’s offer may vary from this range as it may be impacted by additional factors, including but not limited to the candidate's hiring location, qualifications, experience, and market factors.
  
  
Crestron Electronics offers a competitive total compensation package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, 401K with company match, Paid Time Off, Holidays, On-site Amenities at NJ Headquarters & TX Facilities, Crestron Market Cafes, and Fitness Centers.
  
  
At Crestron Electronics, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion drive innovation. Crestron’s success hinges on continuing to build a workforce of unique individuals whose passion inspires us to create and revolutionize industry-leading products and services. There will always be more to accomplish, and at Crestron, we believe the best way forward is together.
  
  
EOE/M/F/D/V
  
  

* No Solicitation\* Any agency submittal to any employee of Crestron Electronics, Inc by any method of communication will be deemed the sole property of Crestron Electronics Inc.

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

HCR embraces a diverse and inclusive work environment by encouraging all individuals, including those with disabilities, to apply to open positions at the agency.

Resilient Homes and Communities (RHC) now serves as the lead principal office responsible for the administration of New York State’s multiple CDBG-DR awards. RHC operates within the New York State Housing Trust Fund Corporation (HTFC) and the Homeownership and Community Development (HOCD) unit, which consists of the State of New York Mortgage Agency, the Affordable Housing Corporation, the Office of Community Renewal, the Office of Special Initiatives and RHC.

**Position Summary**

The Data Analyst will play a key supporting role analyzing, visualizing and reporting data for the Office of Resilient Homes and Communities. This position combines data science, spatial data analysis (GIS) with business and policy research to support reporting, decision-making, and program quality across the agency. Reporting to the Director of Research and Data, the Data Analyst will assist in maintaining spatial and quantitative databases, updating the federal Disaster Recovery Grants Reporting (DRGR) system, and producing maps, dashboards, and reports. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to gain hands-on experience in disaster recovery policy, data integrity, and public sector data analysis.

**Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* **Data & Reporting Support:** Assist in the development, update, and maintenance of performance management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc data analyses to support program operations.
* **GIS & Spatial Analysis:** Support program teams by maintaining Esri ArcGIS software/ArcGIS Online platforms, performing basic spatial analyses, and creating maps and graphs for internal and external stakeholders.
* **System Maintenance:** Help input, track, and verify service areas and program data within New York State’s internal systems and the federal Disaster Recovery Grant Reporting (DRGR) system to ensure accuracy across program records.
* **Data Quality & Documentation:** Assist in documenting data methodologies, maintaining Standards of Procedure (SOPs) for federal reporting, and performing routine data cleaning and quality control.
* **Research Assistance:** Provide analytical and research support for ongoing projects evaluating the impact of RHC programs on New York State residents.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate with internal program teams and external partners to share, transfer, and package data for reporting and research needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field\*
* Knowledge of public policy in areas such as disaster recovery, infrastructure, housing, economic development, and/or resiliency is preferred.
* Experience distilling quantitative and qualitative policy analysis into written descriptions such as briefs, memos, etc.
* 2 years professional experience in an analytic role\*
* Demonstrated experience using Esri ArcGIS 10.x, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, Model Builder, R and basic python programming.
* Excellent oral, written, and quantitative skills.
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional ability to use data to make decisions.
* Expertise in the use of Microsoft Office products, specifically Excel and Access.
* Ability to work in a flexible, fast paced, mission driven environment.
* *Substitutions: four years of specialized experience or associate’s degree and two years of specialized experience may substitute for bachelor’s degree; J.D. or master’s degree may substitute for one year of specialized experience; Ph.D. may substitute for two years of specialized experience.*

*This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will be expected to perform other reasonably related duties as assigned.*

**APPLICANTS MUST INCLUDE A RESUME**

**WHAT WE OFFER AT NYS HCR:**

* Extensive benefits package including participation in New York State’s Health Insurance Program and New York State & Local Employees’ Retirement System.
* Promotional opportunities for dedicated professionals.
* Work-life balance benefits including a 37.5-hour work week, opportunity for compressed scheduling, and paid time off benefits (vacation, sick, personal days, and federal holidays).
* 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave.
* Paid Family Leave.

The PSLF Program forgives the remaining balance on your Direct Loans after you have made 120 qualifying monthly payments under an accepted repayment plan and while working full-time for an eligible employer.

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Healthcare is complex. We're here to change that.

RVO Health is a health technology company on a mission to make health easier to navigate, more accessible, and more affordable for everyone.

Here, you'll help over 40 million people every month, with a team that genuinely cares about the work and each other.

**At a Glance**
---------------

The Senior Business Operations Analyst is a crucial role within our organization, requiring work in various capacities and adaptation to different work arrangements based on the needs set by business.

**Where You'll Be**
-------------------

**Location: New York City, NY | Hybrid**

We believe great collaboration happens when we're together, solving problems, learning from each other, and connecting as a team. That's why we're in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week. You are welcome to work remotely Mondays and Fridays if you wish.

Office address: 250 Park Ave S, New York, NY 10003 (Union Square)

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Provide business operations support and analysis across RVOH Media, helping drive key initiatives such as efficiency, revenue performance, and operational scalability
* Support sales planning and forecasting by analyzing pipeline, bookings, revenue performance, and other key commercial metrics
* Partner with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Sales Operations, to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Build and maintain reporting, dashboards, and tools (Excel, SQL, Google Sheets, or similar) to track KPIs and operational performance
* Translate complex or ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, actionable insights, and clear recommendations
* Support process improvement projects, helping define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and recommend scalable solutions
* Help maintain data quality and operational rigor through standardization, documentation, and governance
* Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership in a clear, actionable way
* Support ad hoc analyses and projects as business needs evolve

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, operations management, or a related field
* 2-5 years experience in business process analysis, process improvement, and operational strategy in driving operational excellence, preferably within the Media industry
* Strong proficiency in Excel and/or SQL, with the ability to build reports and tools that support decision-making
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into clear insights and recommendations
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to varied audiences
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment

**Pursuant to various state Fair Pay Acts, below is a summary of compensation elements for this role at the company. The following benefits are provided by RVO Health, subject to eligibility requirements.**

* Starting Salary: $75,000 - $88,000  
  + *Note actual salary is based on geographic location, qualifications and experience*
* Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision)
* Life Insurance
* Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Paid Time Off
* Holiday Pay
* 401(k) with match
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program
* Pharmacy Benefits
* Income Protection Plans
* Pet Services Plans
* Mental Health Support
* Wellness Coaching
* HSA- Health Savings Account
* Commuter Benefits
* Gym & Fitness Center Discount Program

**Hiring Timeline Notice**  
**THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY 12/31/2026.**

RVO Health is a health-technology company created through a joint venture between Red Ventures and UnitedHealth Group's Optum. Together, we've brought some of the most trusted names in healthcare under one roof, including Healthline, Healthgrades, Fullspan Health, Medical News Today, Optum Perks, and more. We're the #1 source for doctor search in the U.S. Every day, people turn to our brands in moments that matter to find reliable health information, connect with doctors, save money on prescriptions, and take meaningful action on their wellbeing.
