new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Containerized Effects (Active Clearance)
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for time sensitive decisions, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.

Most Warfighting capabilities assume connectivity, compute, power, or a secure space to work in. On a base or near a data center, these exist. At the edge, they do not. Our warfighters need capabilities that can fight where they do. Anduril Expeditionary Systems is the business line that solves this. We build Menace, a containerized system that arrives by truck, ship, plane, or helicopter, powers on in under ten minutes, and delivers command, compute, or effects with no site prep, no bespoke basing equipment, and no specialized personnel.  
  
The Containerized Effects team focuses on clandestine transport, storage, and launch of containerized effects. You'll work with engineers to build enclosures, launch infrastructure, operating interfaces, and communications that let a small team proliferate munitions and non-kinetic effects with minimal support or reachback. Effect is the outcome, not the mechanism: a missile is an effect, and so is electronic warfare.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Lead the day-to-day coordination and execution of program initiatives and tasks, spanning across Anduril teams and SMEs.
* Provide guidance and direction to program team members, including finance, division operations, mission operations, and other stakeholders to enable program execution.
* Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Systems and Software Engineering teams to mature containerized effect program(s) from prototype to production..
* Develop a strong system-level understanding of the business lines and products they support by becoming a power user of Anduril's products — and becoming comfortable with teaching others.
* Deeply understand your customers objectives, constraints, and perspectives.
* Serve as Action Officer for special projects; execute special projects as demanded by the program.
* Drive and set the standard for the program's communications across the team within Anduril and with key customer and government POCs.
* Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, policies, and procedures associated with the program.
* Identify and mitigate potential risks and issues that may impact program delivery.
* Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency within the program.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated experience as a self-starter, able to find and resolve issues on your own
* Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills
* Strong aptitude for problem solving in unstructured situations at the interface of hardware and software. Ability to drive challenging and vague technical problems to clarity and resolution
* Experience in Program Management. Contract management of/with focused program offices
* Experience with government: business development, contract structures, budget cycles, procurement processes, program funding, and proposal processes
* Comfortable with setting and achieving goals in a complex, fast moving environments with ambiguous requirements
* Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow
* Active U.S. Secret clearance

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience as a program or project manager in defense, tech, consulting or similar field
* Experience managing complex projects in government a plus
* Strong technical background with familiarity in systems engineering, software development, networking, and hardware engineering

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

The Program Cybersecurity Manager will play a central role in developing and managing an integrated cybersecurity strategy that protects mission systems and data through 24x7 security operations, advanced AI‑enabled cyber capabilities, enterprise risk management, compliance with NASA and Federal requirements, and coordinated engineering and IT Service Management (ITSM) resources.

  
  

As the Program Cybersecurity Manager supporting this opportunity, you will provide cybersecurity leadership to internal teams and the NASA JPL customers. You will establish, lead and continuously improve the cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk management, architecture, engineering and operations for the program. You will also support GDIT’s account management for NASA JPL with a focus on cyber program growth, customer relationship management, and secure service delivery. This position will ensure that solutions and execution align with modern enterprise cybersecurity best practices, federal mandates, and NASA’s evolving security landscape.

  
  

The successful candidate will be an experienced cybersecurity executive with prior NASA JPL support experience and a proven track record of leading complex cyber programs. The candidate must demonstrate excellence in personnel leadership, customer engagement, enterprise cyber strategy, and driving measurable improvements in security posture. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential for this role, which requires the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment with multiple concurrent workstreams.

  
  

In this Program Cybersecurity Manager role, you will be responsible for executing GDIT’s cybersecurity strategy while ensuring compliance with Federal, NIST, and NASA requirements. This position requires a motivated, seasoned leader who can navigate complex challenges, drive secure solutions with precision, and foster trust-based relationships with internal and customer stakeholders.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration**

* Build and nurture trust with customers by delivering consistent, high-quality cybersecurity results and maintaining transparent communication.

* Set realistic expectations with stakeholders by clearly communicating risk, compliance posture, and mitigation strategies.

* Serve as the primary cybersecurity advisor and point of contact for internal teams and NASA customers, and provides clear, risk-based recommendations on cybersecurity priorities, investments, threats, and program impacts.

  
  

**Strategic Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Strengthen customer experience by ensuring secure service delivery that aligns with NASA mission needs and enterprise security expectations.

  
  

**Cyber Program Management**

* Develop, maintain, and oversee cybersecurity strategy, program plans, and security architecture supporting NASA JPL missions.

* Direct cybersecurity operations teams, engineering teams, and incident response functions to ensure effective execution of NASA and federal security requirements.

* Proactively identify security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats; adjust program plans and defenses as needed to maintain security compliance and resilience.

* Ensure all security deliverables meet required quality standards and comply with NASA, NIST, federal cybersecurity frameworks, and regulatory guidelines.

* Track, analyze, and report on cybersecurity metrics, risks, and program performance using data-driven insights.

* Oversee continuous monitoring, incident response, audit readiness, and enterprise risk management activities.

**Lead Project Manager**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Regular  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Exempt  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
The **Deep Synoptic Array (DSA)** is a next-generation radio telescope being developed for deployment in a radio-quiet valley in Nevada. Comprising 1,650 dishes, the DSA is designed to survey the sky at unprecedented speed and sensitivity. During its five-year initial survey, the DSA is expected to detect more than one billion astronomical sources, produce images and transient alerts in real time, and rapidly deliver science-ready data products to the astronomical community. The DSA brings together scientists, engineers, technical experts, and project professionals across a large, multidisciplinary collaboration. As the project advances toward construction and operations, the DSA offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and delivery of a major new facility at the forefront of radio astronomy.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The Lead Project Manager, in partnership with the Principal Investigator (PI) team and Deputy Project Manager, provides strategic leadership and integrated project management for the design, development, construction, and future operation of the DSA, one of the world's most advanced radio astronomy initiatives. The position is responsible for coordinating project planning, governance, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, environmental compliance, infrastructure development, and organizational planning across a large, multidisciplinary, multi-institutional collaboration.  
  
Working closely with the Principal Investigators, Deputy Project Manager, Project Engineer, institutional leadership, consultants, contractors, funding agencies, and government organizations, the Lead Project Manager ensures alignment across scientific, engineering, technical, operational, and administrative workstreams while supporting the successful execution of the project from conceptual design through construction and operations.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  
  
The Lead Project Manager provides strategic leadership for execution of the DSA project scope, schedule, budget, and integrated project management functions, working in partnership with the Deputy Project Manager and broader project leadership.  

* Serve as the primary project management lead, providing strategic direction across multiple technical, programmatic, and organizational workstreams.
* Lead integrated project planning and execution supporting conceptual design, construction, and long-term operations, including project schedules, budgets, milestones, deliverables, and resource planning.

* Coordinate closely with the broader DSA management team to establish priorities, resolve project issues, and support strategic decision-making as the project advances toward construction and operations.

new_jobs.title: Internal Business Analyst (Operations, Process Improvement & Automation)
new_jobs.description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.

  

We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

  

We're hiring a motivated internally facing **Business Analyst** to learn how CompassX actually runs — across Consulting Operations, Sales, Talent, and more — by getting hands-on with the work itself, then using that ground-level view to identify what's inefficient, recommend a better way, and build it.

This isn't a role where you sit outside the work and hand off recommendations to someone else. You'll learn our processes from the inside, spot where they break down, bring forward a clear fix, and then help make it real. As a small firm, you'll get exposure across nearly every function — no task is too small or too big. It's a high-visibility role with direct exposure to firm leadership from day one.

### **What You'll Do**

* Get hands-on across teams - Consulting Operations, Sales, Talent, and beyond - to genuinely understand how work moves before trying to change it.
* Identify where processes are inefficient, inconsistent, or breaking down, and diagnose why.
* Bring forward clear, practical recommendations for how to fix what's broken or slow.
* Build and implement the fix yourself — whether that's a new process, a piece of documentation, or a lightweight automation.
* Document how key processes work, so decisions and institutional knowledge don't live only in one person's head.
* Partner with leadership and team leads across functions to understand priorities and turn them into real, working improvements.
* Use CRM, spreadsheets, and lightweight automation/AI tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Claude, Gemini, Google Apps Script) as needed to bring recommendations to life.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 1+ year of experience in operations, business analysis, process improvement, or a similar hands-on role - new grads strongly encouraged to apply.
* A genuine curiosity for how things work, and the instinct to diagnose the root cause rather than just patch the symptom.
* Comfortable using (or quickly learning) a CRM, spreadsheet tools, and lightweight automation/AI tools.
* Excellent written communication - comfortable documenting processes clearly and presenting recommendations.
* Highly organized, reliable, and detail-oriented - you like understanding systems and making them better.
* A confident and diplomatic communicator - you'll be working across teams and leadership, tactfully and persistently.
* Takes initiative without being asked, identifies opportunities, and moves work forward independently.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity, shifting priorities, and quickly learning new tools or approaches.
* No ego about the work - you'll take on a genuine mix of tasks, from high-visibility process improvements to basic administrative work, and treat both with the same care.

### **Why CompassX**

* A front-row seat to how a consulting firm builds its from the ground up. You'll help shape it, not just execute someone else's playbook.
* Direct, regular access to firm leadership and real ownership over a function they depend on.

$45,000 - $60,000 a year

The posted range reflects the anticipated compensation for this opportunity. Depending on the role, client requirements, and business needs, compensation may be structured as a salaried position with bonus eligibility or as an hourly contract engagement (including 1099 independent contractor arrangements).

Final compensation and engagement type will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, market conditions, and the nature of the role.

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.

  

With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.

  

At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
### **About**

Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. A laureate of the French government’s selective year list of tech champions, “French Tech Next 120,” we are quickly expanding across Europe.

Over 100 European companies have already seamlessly integrated banking services such as accounts, cards, and payments into their products through our Banking-as-a-Service platform. This approach, known as “embedded finance”, empowers businesses to elevate their offerings and create new revenue streams — often times tripling their revenue!

Our founders’ vision from the beginning was Simplicity: that anyone with a fintech idea at 2 am can visit our website, start building, and buy themselves a coffee with a self-issued card the very next day. That vision has taken us far.

Following a 38M€ Series B round last September, we have been doubling our headcount and already have over 230 Swanees across offices in Paris, Bordeaux, Berlin, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Milan! If you’re excited about joining a European fintech adventure, Swan is the way!

**To learn more about us:** **About Swan** **;** **Our story****.**

### **Job description**

Swan is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data team, led by Romain, our VP Data. The team has 9 people across data engineering, analytics engineering and data analysis.

This is a hybrid role. Half of it is being a business partner: you'll work hand in hand with your stakeholders, help them ask the right questions, and turn data into recommendations that shape their decisions.

The other half is making data work better at Swan. As our team has grown, so has the variety in how we build dashboards, define KPIs and document our work. You'll lead the effort to harmonize these practices and bring the team along with you. You'll also run initiatives that help the rest of Swan get more value from data, such as Metabase training and data onboarding for new Swanees.

Think of it as RevOps for data: you'll shape not only what we deliver, but how we work.

**Your mission**

Your mission has two sides:

**Data analysis:**

* **Owner of your domain's data logic:** Make sure the data in your scope reflects how the business really works. Define and maintain KPIs, investigate edge cases, write clear specifications for the modeling logic, and safeguard data quality. When needed, you'll build the dbt models yourself.
* **Data product manager for your dashboards:** Build and maintain the Metabase dashboards and EXCO reports for your domain. Treat them as products: understand how they're used, keep them reliable and relevant, and retire what's no longer needed.

* **Turn ideas into delivered projects:** Take improvement ideas from across the team, including leadership's, and turn them into structured projects with a clear scope, plan and owners. Then carry them through to the end, long after the kick-off energy has faded.
* **Harmonize how the data team works:** Lead internal initiatives that make the team more efficient and consistent, such as a shared dashboard lifecycle, a common process for defining and validating KPIs, the data catalog and its upkeep, and clear documentation of our practices.

* You're **pragmatic about process**: you know how to keep standards lightweight and focused on what really solves the problem.
* You have **grit and follow-through**: you're the person who turns ideas into reality, keeps momentum when things get slow or messy, and doesn't let a project quietly die.
* You enjoy **sharing knowledge**: training, documentation, onboarding or helping others become autonomous with data.
* You handle **sensitive or confidential data** with care and discretion.
* You're excited by a **hybrid role**, half business partner, half making the team and the company work better with data.
* You share our values: **team spirit, transparency, ownership**, and the humility to keep learning.

**Even better if:**

* You have experience with **dbt** or building data marts.

new_jobs.title: Senior Business Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
***Before we get started:***  
Here at Ingenio, we'd love to talk with you regardless of your qualifications or years of experience. If you believe you'd be a great fit for this role, we invite you to apply even if you do not meet all points on the job description.

***Who we are:***  
Ingenio is on a mission to make spiritual wellness a core part of modern self-care. We are a global media and technology company developing products that provide guidance on love, relationships, careers, and all aspects of life. We are passionate about connecting people with the world's best advisors and content to restore spiritual wellness to its rightful place, easing the stress of modern life with trusted ancient practices.

Our global portfolio spans over 20 marketplace and media brands in the spiritual and emotional wellness space. Our flagship brands include Keen, Horoscope.com, Astrology.com, Purple Garden, Kasamba, and Kang.

***How you'll be impactful:***  
We are seeking a Senior Business Data Analyst to elevate our understanding of financial, product, and marketing performance across our EU brand portfolio. The ideal candidate will have expertise in B2C financial monitoring, marketplace dynamics, product analytics, and marketing analytics, along with experience analyzing interactions between buyers and sellers. This role involves communicating insights to executive leadership and partnering with Marketplace Success, Product, and Marketing teams by developing and managing Tableau reports that track key metrics, playing a critical part in shaping strategic direction and optimizing brand performance. Our European data currently sits across multiple local and international systems, so a key part of this role is connecting and reconciling these sources into a consistent, trusted view of performance.  
  
*Please note: This role will require being in our Paris office at least 3 days per week.*

  

***What*** ***you'll be doing:***

* Lead financial analysis of brand results: Revenue, Engagement, Retention; and create analysis to better understand both supply and demand behavior.
* Connect and reconcile data across local and international systems to build a consistent, trusted view of European performance.
* Partner with executive leadership to surface insights and drive accountability and growth.
* Partner with Marketplace Success to increase retention and monetization of loyal customers; utilization and revenue of sellers.
* Analyze product usage and user behavior to inform feature development, funnel optimization, and onboarding improvements, partnering closely with Product teams.
* Evaluate marketing campaign performance across channels, including acquisition efficiency, attribution, and ROAS, partnering closely with Marketing teams.
* Proactively explore available data to generate actionable insights and advocate strategies that increase business value.
* Maintain reports, decks and dashboards that track KPIs and provide insights into marketplace, product, and marketing effectiveness and ROI.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify key issues and opportunities, support business strategy based on data-driven insights.

***What*** ***you'll need to be successful:***

* 5+ years of experience analyzing marketplace operations, revenue analytics, product analytics, marketing analytics, consulting, finance, or business strategy.
* Bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, economics or related quantitative fields.
* Exceptional skills in Google Sheets, Excel, Slides, Powerpoint, data extraction and analysis.
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Skilled in Tableau/Data visualization software. Familiarity with Python and/or R is a plus.
* Experience working with fragmented or legacy data environments (multiple local/international systems) is a strong plus.
* Experience in analysis of revenue, customer behavior and marketplace dynamics. Familiarity with Product Analytics tools (Mixpanel) and marketing analytics/attribution platforms is a plus.
* Proven ability to frame and solve problems by extracting insight from raw data.
* Team player with a result-oriented approach, capable of navigating ambiguity and initiating/driving projects to completion.
* Expert in creation of presentations and reports for executive leadership to communicate findings, recommendations, and performance metrics. Exceptional communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Fluent French and English required; German is a plus given the European scope of this role.

***Perks & Benefits:***

* Collaborative, high-performing, and entrepreneurial team
* Employee referral bonus program
* Company swag
* Birthday PTO
* Summer Fridays
* Meal vouchers
* Learning & development support, including dedicated budget
* Regular in-person and virtual team events

***Why Ingenio?***  
Our growing team of over 300 employees is powered by our diverse perspectives and company core values:

* We are humble. We believe the best result is achieved by leveraging others' perspectives
* We think like owners. We make decisions that optimize for the greater good of the organization
* We challenge limiting beliefs. We are at our best when we identify and shatter status quo expectations

*Ingenio is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.*

**We Are**

Accenture's Cybersecurity practice, a global leader in delivering end-to-end cybersecurity services across strategy, risk management, digital identity, cyber defense, and managed security. With security professionals in 70 countries and specialized facilities like Cyber Fusion Centers and Cyber Labs, we focus on embedding security into digital transformation programs, and delivering targeted cybersecurity solutions to protect digital assets, manage cybersecurity risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. We address the evolving challenges of cybersecurity in today's digital landscape. Our cybersecurity practice is supported by a global network of cybersecurity professionals, advanced tools, and partnerships with leading technology providers. We help organizations build resilience, protect their operations, and enable growth in a secure digital environment.

**You Are**

Passionate about leveraging cybersecurity innovation to drive strategic transformation across the Chemicals & Natural Resources (CNR) industries, including chemical manufacturers, oil & gas operators, mining companies, and agricultural enterprises. You develop and deliver cybersecurity services that protect critical infrastructure, enable operational modernization, manage enterprise and operational risk, and support compliance with industry-specific regulatory requirements. This role demands deep expertise across IT and OT environments and the ability to guide CNR clients through complex business, technology, safety, and resilience challenges. You assess current and future cybersecurity capabilities, advise on leading practices, and shape cybersecurity strategies aligned with each client's business priorities, regulatory obligations, and operational realities.

**The Work:**

As a Cybersecurity Manager, you will manage complex information security engagements and workstreams. You will provide cybersecurity subject matter expertise, coordinate project delivery, and serve as a key point of contact for client security, business, and IT stakeholders, Accenture domain experts, and third-party teams. You will lead; manage plans, risks, budgets, and deliverables; and help shape practical solutions that achieve committed client outcomes.

As a team member, you'll be part of a Chemicals & Natural Resources industry team focused on applying cybersecurity expertise across the CNR value chain — from upstream exploration and extraction, to refining, processing, and distribution, through to chemical manufacturing and end-product delivery. You'll work closely with our CNR industry leaders to innovate and shape secure, resilient solutions for operational technology modernization, supply chain security, and industrial process safety.

new_jobs.title: Deal Strategy Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are seeking a **Deal Strategy Program Manager** to help us scale how we support our sales organization. This role is a critical partner to sales and collaborates closely with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations, helping move deals forward with speed, sound judgment, and operational rigor. Beyond executing day-to-day deal support, this role independently owns complex deals end-to-end, shapes the processes and systems the broader team relies on, and is a go-to resource for less-experienced teammates.

You'll play a central role in structuring deals, improving process quality, and helping our sales team close business efficiently and responsibly. We're looking for someone who operates with real autonomy, exercises sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and is energized by solving problems in a fast-paced environment. This is a strong next step for someone who has built foundational deal desk or revenue operations experience and is ready to own outcomes independently, influence process and policy, and begin mentoring others.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own Deal Execution**

* Serve as a senior, trusted advisor to Sales leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on structuring and executing complex, non-standard, and high-value deals
* Independently evaluate and resolve non-standard deal requests, driving cross-functional solutions across Sales, Finance, and Legal with minimal oversight
* Own deals end-to-end through quoting, approval, contracting, and quote-to-cash — troubleshooting issues with Finance and Legal with urgency, accuracy, and attention to policy and business context
* Ensure all transactions adhere to internal revenue recognition policies, escalating and resolving edge cases as needed
* Present deal strategy recommendations and insights to senior stakeholders in a clear, concise, data-driven manner

**Elevate Operational Quality**

* Ensure deal data is complete and accurate in CRM, with a focus on data hygiene and process compliance
* Reinforce and help enforce pricing and discounting governance, exercising judgment in gray areas rather than simply applying rules
* Define requirements for system enhancements (e.g., CRM, CPQ) in partnership with systems and RevOps teams

**Drive Process Improvement & Scale**

* Proactively identify friction in current processes and lead improvements — including automation and AI (e.g., AI-assisted contract review, quote generation, deal analytics) — to increase speed, consistency, and scale, and reduce manual effort
* Own the optimization of policies, playbooks, and standard operating procedures for deal support, and lead their rollout and adoption across the global team
* Act as a go-to resource for other analysts on sales operations planning, process, and execution

**Support & Mentor**

* Informally mentor newer Revenue Operations Support Analysts on deal structuring, systems, and policy
* Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing — documentation, training sessions, and onboarding materials — recommending process changes and leading training so improvements scale beyond a single deal

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean**
-----------------------------------

* Business Degree
* 5-7+ years of experience (Deal Desk, Finance, Pricing or Sales Operations experience required), software industry experience preferred.
* Demonstrated experience independently owning complex deals or projects, not just executing defined tasks
* Experience supporting SaaS, cloud, or technology sales organizations
* Strong fluency in systems like Salesforce, CPQ tools, and reporting platforms, with an eye toward data integrity for downstream reporting and forecasting
* Sound judgment for navigating ambiguous or non-standard deal situations, knowing when to escalate versus resolve independently
* A track record of recommending and helping implement process or policy improvements
* Contract management and negotiation experience strongly preferred
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with first-principles thinking
* Self-starter mentality with a proactive eagerness to learn, mentor others, and level up the revenue operations team
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing stakeholder needs in a fast-paced environment
* Experience using or implementing AI or automation tools (e.g., generative AI, workflow automation, CPQ automation) to improve deal desk efficiency and accuracy a plus

**Compensation Range:**
-----------------------

* $90,000 - $120,000

* This is a remote role

*#LI-Remote*

**Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean**
--------------------------------------------

* **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.
* **We prioritize career development.** At DO, you'll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. The Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Operations and Performance Support division at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory plays a critical role in enabling world-class science through operational excellence and regulatory compliance. Reporting to the EHS Division Deputy for Operations, the **Operations Systems Program Manager** leads a Division-wide program covering business systems, data and performance management, strategic initiatives, and assigned program operations. This role directly supervises a team of experienced professionals across the Business Systems Team and ProgramData Management Team, setting multi-year objectives, establishing program roadmaps, and leading complex initiatives from planning through implementation and transition to sustained operations.

**We're here for the same mission, to bring science solutions to the world. Join our team and YOU will play a supporting role in our goal to address global challenges! Have a high level of impact and work for an organization associated with 17 Nobel Prizes!**

***Why join Berkeley Lab?***

We invest in our employees by offering a total rewards package you can count on:

* Exceptional health and retirement benefits, including pension or 401K-style plans
* Opportunities to grow in your career - check out our Tuition Assistance Program
* A culture where you’ll belong - we are invested in our teams!
* In addition to accruing vacation and sick time, we also have a Winter Holiday Shutdown every year.
* Parental bonding leave (for both mothers and fathers)
* Pet insurance

  

**What you’ll do:**

*Set direction and deliver results*

* Set priorities and develop a multi-year roadmap for EHS business systems and performance work, aligned with EHS priorities and Laboratory strategy.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation, managing scope, resources, schedules, risks, and outcomes.
* Advise EHS Division Deputy for Operations on priorities, emerging issues, investments, and opportunities to improve operations.

*Improve systems, data, and processes*

* Lead the EHS business systems portfolio, partnering with IT and EHS teams to improve applications, data, and workflows.
* Guide system projects through requirements, testing, deployment, and transition to ongoing support.
* Strengthen metrics, dashboards, data quality, reporting, and analysis to help EHS leadership understand performance measures, manage risks, and make strategic decisions.
* Bridge the gap between EHS strategic goals, workflows, and technical operations

*Lead people and manage resources*

* Supervise, coach, and develop experienced professionals across the Business Systems and Program Data Management teams.
* Build an inclusive, accountable team and plan for staffing, workload, and future needs.
* Oversee assigned budgets, vendors, procurement activities, and program reporting.

  

**You will have:**

* A bachelor’s or advanced degree in business administration, information systems, applied mathematics, statistics, data analytics, operations management, program or project management or a related field, or equivalent training and experience.
* Experience leading programs and setting priorities, plans, budgets, and measures of success.
* Experience supervising professionals and working across technical and business teams.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using data, metrics, or reporting to inform decisions.
* Knowledge of business systems, process improvement, project delivery, and/or change management.
* The judgment and communication skills to advise leaders, build relationships, and work through competing priorities.

  

**Desired skills/knowledge:**

* Advanced degree in business administration, information systems, data analytics, operations management or a related field.
* 12 years of related experience.
* Experience in a scientific, research, higher education, government contractor or other highly regulated environment.
* Experience working with DOE, UC or Berkeley Lab policies, systems and management practices.
* Experience evaluating automation or AI applications for business processes, data analysis or customer service.

  

**Additional information:**

* **Application date:** Priority consideration will be given to candidates who apply by **October 19, 2026**. Applications will be accepted until the job posting is removed. Appointment type: This is a full-time career appointment, exempt (monthly paid) from overtime pay.
* **Salary range:** The expected salary for this position is $193,000.00 - $210,000.00, depending upon the candidate’s skills, knowledge, and abilities. This includes education, certifications, and years of experience.
* **Background check:** This position is subject to a background check. Any convictions will be evaluated to determine if they directly relate to the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Having a conviction history will not automatically disqualify an applicant from being considered for employment.
* **Work modality:** Work will be primarily performed at:Lawrence Berkeley National Lab, 1 Cyclotron Road, Berkeley, CA. A REAL ID or other acceptable form of identification is required to access Berkeley Lab sites (for more information, ).
* **Work authorization:** Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

  

**Want to learn more about working at Berkeley Lab? Please visit:** **careers.lbl.gov**

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Program Manager and Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Digital Test & Evaluation (T&E)** tohelp modernize traditional defense T&E processes through digital engineering, modeling and simulation, software integration, data orchestration, DevSecOps, and cloud and edge technologies. This role will support the development and implementation of an enterprise Digital T&E ecosystem that connects users, tools, data, models, simulations, and test resources to enable faster, more continuous, data-driven testing and decision-making. Working across test organizations, program offices, ranges, laboratories, cybersecurity teams, operational users, and commercial vendors, the Technical Program Manager will translate mission and technical requirements into executable pilots, software requirements, integration plans, and transition strategies to support the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU).

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage Digital T&E prototype efforts from problem definition and market research through technical diligence, pilot execution, user evaluation, and transition.
* Translate military T&E workflows, capability claims, operational needs, and program decisions into software requirements, user stories, integration requirements, acceptance criteria, and measurable pilot outcomes.
* Design and evaluate end-to-end T&E workflows that connect requirements, mission and systems engineering, modeling and simulation, test planning, test execution, test data collection, analysis, reporting, and decision support.
* Apply working knowledge of test strategy and design to help teams define Measures of Performance (MoPs), Measures of Effectiveness (MoEs), test objectives, data requirements, evidence thresholds, and the appropriate mix of modeling and simulation, laboratory, cyber, and physical-range testing.
* Serve as a technical integrator across Digital T&E tool categories including mission engineering, systems engineering / MBSE, DevSecOps and CI/CD, modeling and simulation, detailed test planning, risk management, test execution, test-data monitoring, test management, analysis, visualization, reporting, and data governance.
* Develop and validate digital-thread concepts that allow authoritative data and artifacts to flow between engineering, test, and assessment tools without unnecessary manual re-entry or duplication.
* Coordinate integration of commercial software into defense RDT&E infrastructure, including government and commercial cloud, edge environments, RDT&E networks, and classified/unclassified enclaves, while accounting for cybersecurity, identity and access management, data protection, interoperability, and accreditation requirements.
* Identify and resolve technical barriers associated with APIs, data schemas, metadata, containerization, software deployment, network connectivity, data federation, tool interoperability, and integration with existing systems of record.
* Work with Government test organizations, program offices, users, data owners, security teams, software vendors, and infrastructure providers to establish realistic pilot architectures and execution plans.
* Conduct technical due diligence of commercial software and emerging T&E technologies, assessing product maturity, architectural fit, interoperability, security posture, data rights, scalability, user experience, and potential to improve T&E outcomes.
* Create and lead collaborative teams of Government and commercial entities to prototype, integrate, test, and evaluate commercial Digital T&E solutions in operationally relevant environments.
* Develop executive-level briefs, test concepts, pilot plans, integration roadmaps, decision memos, and other technically sound documentation that clearly communicates program status, risks, outcomes, and recommendations.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Five or more years of directly relevant experience in defense Test & Evaluation, systems engineering, digital engineering, software-intensive acquisition, or a closely related national-security technical field.

**Skills and Experience:**

* Working knowledge of the defense T&E lifecycle, including test strategy, developmental and operational testing, test planning and execution, MOPs/MOEs, risk management, data collection, analysis, reporting, and the role of modeling and simulation versus physical test.
* Demonstrated familiarity with one or more Digital T&E / digital engineering disciplines such as MBSE, mission engineering, modeling and simulation, digital twins, test management, DevSecOps/CI/CD, automated test, data orchestration, data analytics/visualization, AI/ML, or digital-thread architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and manage software integration in defense environments, including APIs and data exchange, cloud and edge deployment, containerized applications, government networks, cybersecurity/RMF and ATO processes, identity/access controls, CUI and classified-data handling, and interoperability with legacy systems.
* Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to translate operational and test-user problems into technically actionable software requirements and pilot architectures.
* Experience working across Government program offices, test organizations, engineering organizations, operational users, and commercial technology companies.
* Experience with rapid acquisition or non-traditional acquisition pathways such as CSOs and OTAs is highly desirable.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment in planning and executing complex Digital T&E initiatives, proactively identifying technical, integration, and execution risks and providing recommendations to senior Government stakeholders.
* Strong engineering literacy in a relevant discipline such as Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.

new_jobs.title: Site Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Site Security Manager**

**About the role:** The Site Security Manager (SSM) serves as the day-to-day manager of a 24/7 datacenter physical security operations team, supporting a client’s datacenter or other critical facility. Reporting to a Campus Security Manager (CSM), the SSM builds a cohesive, high-performing team that delivers a safe, secure, and compliant environment while meeting client expectations. The SSM also collaborates with other campus security leaders to maintain consistent security standards across the campus. Additional responsibilities may include client service and issue resolution, service enhancements, Security Operations Center (SOC) systems maintenance, audit compliance, system monitoring, log and documentation maintenance, and access rights administration. Based on coverage needs, the SSM may be required to support and provide leadership coverage at other assigned sites within the campus/region in addition to their primary site.

**What you’ll do:** In this role, the Site Security Manager (SSM) leads the on‑site security team and oversees day‑to‑day security operations within a 24/7 environment. You are responsible for directly managing security personnel, including administrative officers, responders, control room staff, and other security team members, while ensuring consistent staffing coverage and operational continuity.

You partner with local leadership to support recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, and employee development. This includes coaching and mentoring team members, setting expectations, and managing performance and corrective actions in line with company policy. You also work closely with client leadership across multiple business groups to support site operations.

Operationally, you ensure compliance with security policies, procedures, and standard operating guidelines. You monitor site performance and key metrics, identify risks or security gaps, and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement. You maintain required documentation, logs, and reports, oversee on‑site security systems such as access control, CCTV, and incident management tools, and support audits, inspections, and other compliance activities.

The role requires clear, professional communication with clients and internal partners, including leading meetings and presentations. You escalate significant events and risks as needed, promote safe work practices, handle sensitive information with discretion, and support additional operational needs as they arise.

**What you need to apply:** To apply for this role, you should have an associate degree and 6+ years of relevant experience in the security industry, including 3+ years of managing people. Experience leading teams in a security and/or datacenter environment is strongly preferred. You should also have hands‑on experience with security technologies such as CCTV, access control systems, incident management tools, and video surveillance platforms. Strong, practical proficiency with Microsoft Office is expected, as reporting, documentation, and operational tracking are essential parts of the role.

This position is best suited for a proven people leader who is comfortable balancing operational leadership, administrative accountability, and client‑facing responsibilities within a 24/7 security environment.

All applicants must have reliable means of communication and transportation (public or private) to travel to and from work, the legal right to work in the country where the position is located, and proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing in English and a common local language (where applicable).

Applicants must also be able and willing to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays (such as during emergencies or high‑priority events). Applicants must be able to meet and continue to meet licensing requirements for security officers, as applicable to local, county, and state laws and regulations.

**What you’ll get:** We offer more than just a job; we offer the chance to be part of a collaborative and supportive team where your contributions are valued and your growth matters. In this role, you will thrive in a dynamic environment while supporting a prestigious multinational client account. You will gain exposure to global operations and cross-regional collaboration, and you will have access to continuous learning, training programs, and career development opportunities designed to help you succeed.

**The extra stuff:** Candidates must be at least 18 years old, legally authorized to work in the job location, and willing to complete the company’s pre‑employment screening, including a background check and drug screening. This role may require evening, overnight, or weekend work, particularly during emergencies or high‑priority events. Work may occur in outdoor or inclement weather or environments requiring protective gear and heightened safety awareness. The role requires the physical ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods (up to 12 miles/19 km per shift), climb stairs, and occasionally lift up to 25 pounds (11 kg).

The posted salary represents the lowest and highest ranges RV Tech reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position. Any posted salary range pertains only to the estimated starting pay for the role. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location.

  

**About Us**
============

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

**Role Summary**
================

RVT vehicles for Volkswagen Group programs combine RVT zonal and platform ECUs with secondary ECUs (2nd ECUs) supplied by the VWG brands. Every RVT domain team has to integrate against those 2nd ECUs, and all of it depends on a shared network interface definition. Today that definition is largely handed to us by VWG and our domains are mainly taking in what they receive. We need to move to a world where each RVT domain owns its interfaces and changes flow incrementally rather than in large releases.

You will join the SW Systems Architecture team and partner with the interface architecture leads to run the network interface program inside RVT, drive the transition from consuming VWG's definition to domain owned interfaces, roll out the frameworks the architects define for 2nd ECUs, and give domain teams and leadership one current view of where each 2nd ECU stands. The architects set the technical direction. You turn it into a plan, a cadence and a set of artifacts the organization can execute against.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Own the program plan for taking the RVT network interface to a fully defined and versioned baseline for each VWG program (Package 1, Package 2.1, Package 2.2 and beyond).
* Map out and drive the transition plan, per domain and per program, for moving interface ownership from VWG into the RVT domains, including what has to be true at each step and where the interim dependencies on VWG remain.
* Document and roll out the workflow the architects define for network interface versioning and change management inside RVT, including how incoming VWG interface changes are reviewed, how deltas reach the domains and how changes get closed out.
* Run the domain review cadence for interface changes and chase open items to closure across the domain teams.
* Coordinate network definition change requests from VWG, making sure impact is assessed by the right RVT owners and the outcome gets back to VWG.
* Roll out the framework the architects define for what has to be captured per 2nd ECU (functional spec, network interface needs, SW and HW version plan, OTA compliance, integration prerequisites), drive the domains to fill it in, and roll up the results.
* Maintain the up to date view of 2nd ECU maturity and risk per program that can be escalated to RVT and VWG leadership, and make the gaps visible when information from the brands does not exist.
* Operate the handoff between architecture level definition and the active integration tracking owned by the domain and program TPM teams.
* Set up the forums, status rhythm and documentation for this area, and act as the point of contact for VWG TPM counterparts on networking and 2nd ECU planning.

**Qualifications**
==================

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* 8+ years of technical program management on products that integrate hardware, software and mechanical systems, including embedded or vehicle programs taken from concept to production.
* Strong organization and the ability to influence and move an organization without direct authority, across every domain team and two parent companies.
* Experience planning and driving multi-step transitions of ownership or process across teams while the program keeps moving.
* Comfort in ambiguity. You can take a framework from the technical leads, turn it into a working process and artifacts, and iterate as the program evolves.
* Enough hands-on software or hardware background to follow architecture discussions and ask the right questions of architects and domain engineers.
* Experience bridging Agile and waterfall processes across partner organizations. Advanced Jira and Confluence.

**Total Rewards**
-----------------

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

**Your Impact:**  
Cisco is seeking a Senior Manager, Finance PMO, to provide strategic support to the SVP of Corporate Finance and the broader FP organization. This high-impact leadership role is responsible for driving organizational transformation, innovation, and operational excellence at scale. You will run critically important programs across global Finance teams and cross-functional partners, ensuring transparency and alignment with corporate objectives.
  
By demonstrating critical thinking and operational difficulty, you will reduce organizational friction, standardize operational practices, and champion the adoption of AI and new technologies to enable scalable automation and predictive insights. You will serve as a key partner to teams across Finance (including Corporate, GTM, and Product FP) and cross-functional organizations such as IT, People, Engineering, and Pricing. Your success will be defined by your ability to plan and implement effectively, encouraging collaboration across teams with varied strengths to drive transformative change.
  
  
Corporate Finance Project and Program Management

new_jobs.title: Legal Operations Program Manager, M&A Integrations
new_jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

We are looking for a high-impact Legal Operations Program Manager to join our expanding Legal Operations Team and sit at the center of our mergers & acquisitions (M&A) activity! This is a strategy-to-execution role focused on post-acquisition integration: bringing acquired companies' legal teams, legal entities, contracts, litigation and matters, outside counsel relationships, and compliance obligations into the Lyft Legal organization. To be clear, this is a business and organizational M&A integration role, not a systems or technology integration role. You will serve as the operating backbone for Legal across our most strategic transactions, owning the legal workstream of M&A integration in partnership with Lyft's Corporate Development Integration Management Office (IMO), along with the intake and governance layer that connects the Legal team to deal work. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, proactive, and able to drive outcomes across multiple concurrent acquisitions in ambiguous, high-stakes environments with a collaborative and transparent approach. Some key areas include: M&A integration program management, program leadership across concurrent deals, cross-functional and deal team engagement, outside counsel and vendor management across jurisdictions, legal entity management and governance, and building a repeatable M&A integration operating model that scales with company growth. This position reports to the Head of Legal Operations.

As the company scales, the volume and complexity of strategic transactions — acquisitions, cross-border expansion, and new market entry — continues to increase. This role establishes a centralized operating model for the legal side of M&A integration that ensures:

* Acquisitions are integrated into Lyft Legal with discipline, completeness, and a clear critical path
* Legal is embedded early in each deal, from diligence through post-close, with strong planning-to-execution across multiple teams to deliver strong business results and manage risk
* The organization scales without inheriting unmanaged legal, contractual, or compliance risk from acquired companies

* **Program Leadership & Execution**

  + Coordinate a hub-and-spoke model that maps acquired legal team members, contracts, and matters to the appropriate Lyft Legal functional owners, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early
  + Support the organizational integration of acquired legal teams, including role mapping, reporting lines, onboarding, and adoption of Lyft Legal policies and ways of working
